freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:200:description

Reward: Required for hiring and upgrading troops

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:201:description
Reward: According to intelligence, Dominion hold a strategically important prisoner of war in their advanced camp. My enemy's enemy is my friend. We need to release him.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:202:description
Reward: We need to capture the Reiber bridge to gain a foothold in the sector. This bridge is the key location of the Crimson Dominion  supply chain. Of course, the bridge is well guarded. Get ready, it will be hot!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:203:description
Reward: Even though the enemy evacuated the prisoner in time, they can not go far. The only chance to leave the sector is the railway station near Fredholm, where we will intercept them.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:204:description
Reward: Sandy border is the zone between the Dominion sector and the marauder wastelands. Open confrontations of these two forces for strategic positions and minerals, happen here from time to time.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:205:description
Reward: Capturing Reiber bridge serve as a base for the deployment of sabotage activities in the heart of the Crimson Dominion. And although its influence in the sector is great, a start has been made. The next move will be ours, we need to act now!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:206:description
Reward: Imperials like to say: "Don't wanna meet the Dominion patrols, go farther to the Border". And this is the truth. Fracture peak is the gate to the wastelands and Dominion's patrols and convoys don't go beyond it.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:207:description
Reward: We moved quite deep into the Border, passed the Fracture peak, but still haven't met worthy resistance or serious threat. Did the legends exaggerate the danger of these lands?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:208:description
Reward: There were several alarms from the guard this night, but no attacks followed. We better be prepared for the marauders visit at dawn and take comfortable positions for defense.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:209:description
Reward: Factory warehouses of Ardheim were decommissioned a long time ago, but still look untouched. On the one hand, this fact provokes well-founded suspicions, but at the same time, the Ardheim factory is known as a manufacturer of advanced weapons.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:210:description
Reward: What we faced with resembles marauders of the vast wastelands only remotely. It seems that due to various reasons, raiders have undergone a number of mutations that have distorted their appearance, eclipsed their minds, but endowed them with superhuman strength and endurance.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:211:description
Reward: We have to continue studying mutated marauders in order to detect all the mutation consequences, to find vulnerabilities and ways to solve the current situation. World that we want to build doesn't need a permanent genetic threat at hand.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:212:description
Reward: Scouts report that the Dominion forces are preparing an ambush. We must destroy their plans at the preparation stage.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:213:description
Reward: Way to the continent is blocked by the Dominion defense line, attacking them will be a suicide mission. The only vulnerable place is the coast. It is well guarded, but we seem to have no other choice.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:214:description
Reward: As was expected, Dominion soldiers were taken by surprise and were forced to retreat. Let's send a couple troops to track their officer-in-command. Such information won't be received in vain.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:215:description
Reward: It seems after losing Reiber bridge and supply chain, Dominion began to transport resources by the sea. If we stop this load, we'll deal a severe damage to its capabilities and authority.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:216:description
Reward: Successful execution of the mission on the coast will force the Dominion to draw its troops from all over the sector in one place. This should reduce the number of patrols in populated areas and simplify the task for our combined troops.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:217:description
Reward: During the persecution our scouts came across a small mining village. Only the Dominion garrison stands in the way for the unplanned steel delivery.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:218:description
Reward: Western part of the sector is densely inhabited: settlements, factories, cities and fortresses of the Dominion, entirely populated by sectarians and possessed. We lost the officer's track in the first settlement. We should wait for anything, and therefore act with the utmost caution.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:219:description
Reward: One of the locals mentioned a military archive of the Dominion, disguised as one of the abandoned buildings south of our disposition. We just need to figure out what building it is.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:220:description
Reward: It seems to act secretly is the only available option in this situation. That is, of course, unless we want to be torn up by a crowd of mad fanatics. So let's eliminate the key targets quickly, without creating unnecessary noise.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:221:description
Reward: Looks like we identified the building with archive. Surveillance didn't detect security, but this doesn't mean that there is no one.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:222:description
Reward: This colony is filled with. After analyzing all the collected information it became clear that occultism was born and began to spread actively in these places from a certain Prophet. I'm sure if we use some force, we'll get much more extensive information.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:223:description
Reward: The Apostle Roarke. All that we managed to find out from the last operation is the name of the Prophet. No more. He is constantly in the mind, preaching, but it's not so easy to track him down. But the place and date of the next sermon the residents do not know, well, or simply do not give out.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:224:description
Reward: Roarke feels that we are approaching and sent his most devoted followers from the occult adepts. You can say - took active measures. Well, today his pack will become noticeably smaller.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:226:description
Reward: It seems that one of the adepts had a carelessness to keep a diary. Two events are marked in red. Judging by the records, on one of them Roark will appear. You can not risk, you need to check both.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:228:description
Reward: Having found the proper documentation on one of the abandoned Ardheim Industries factories, we will decipher the mutagen coding and determine the factory location and we'll be able to stop its production.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:231:description
Reward: Our scouts spotted Marshal Kragg on the enemy's premises. It seems that we interfere with the Dominion's plans so much that they deployed one of the most experienced generals to fight us. It won't be easy, but Kragg's liquidation is our priority now.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:236:description
Reward: It seems that the Dominion military authority hopes to stop us from moving deeper into the sector with our tank weapons' power. Personal tank division of Chancellor Doomerville is not a joke but we are also not joking.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:242:description
Reward: Today we will deal a devastating damage to the Dominion. Today the story of one of the bloodiest marshals will end. Today, Kragg will answer for his crimes before the people of the Empire. To arms!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:243:description
Reward: Impudence of previous operation didn't go unnoticed, but this is only to our advantage. Anger outshines the mind, and Dominion patrols are clearly angery. The best opportunity to skip past them may not be presented.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:244:description
Reward: Our advancing troops did try to evade surveillance but it seems that we didn't manage to go completely unnoticed. Now we need to tie up the loose ends and entirely disappear behind the enemy lines.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:245:description
Reward: We are approaching the Reinstein fortress, a godforsaken place. Thousands and thousands of Dominion residents, sectarians and possessed sought refuge in this fortress, but were forced to settle in the slums near its walls, never getting inside. We need to be alert.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:283:description
Reward: Modification of the Reifling rifle with a cylinder loading system will reduce the reloading time for Infantrymen.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:293:description
Reward: Improvement over ventilation systems of "Hammer" walking machine can positively affect crew's health, which will allow them to stay in combat-ready state longer.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:294:description
Reward: After setting up the production line, the "Guardian" walker will be assembled there. This will minimize any oversight in details, standardize them and upgrade the quality of finished machines by an order of magnitude.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:295:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:1:description
Reward: Many years have passed since the time of the massacre at Grimhelm, which became the turning point of the First Occult Wars. Sons of the Empire fought bravely, but were doomed long before the battle began. We underestimated the power of the Dark Gods and cruelly paid for it. Thousands of fighters died, more were taken into slavery or Occult faith, the Empire fell and its name was forgotten. For many years we lived in fear under the Dominion rule. But the number of those who were dissatisfied with the regime and ready to fight grew every day. So the resistance was born. In order not to endanger the civilians, we had to go to the mountains, where we found the ruins of the Osterberg fortress. Now our wanderings have come to an end. We found a new home, we pay for it in blood and steel. It was worth it, because today will be remembered as the beginning of the Iron Empire Renaissance.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:2:description
Reward: There is nothing more reliable than iron. The Empire has "Iron" in its name for a good reason - the value of this material can not be overemphasized. Iron is the base component of steel, the most popular metal in the Empire, our engineers have learned to use it everywhere, from the production of weapons to the strengthening of the armored walking machines. Workers cast steel into suitable shapes and harden it in the foundry. It is recommended that you upgrade foundry equipment regularly to increase production, as well as provide additional storage space for finished products. Construction of additional foundries should not be neglected. Steel is the basis of our Rising Empire and if the Dominion does not lay down its weapons peacefully, it will be lucky to taste our steel power.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:3:description
Reward: Finally taking Osterberg under the control of the Rising Empire forces, we began the deployment of the camp. key buildings were constructed and we were faced with the problem of storing mined materials and resources. We feared robbers and marauders, as well as the risk of storing flammable substances under the open sky. However, we found the solution for this problem - after converting the abandoned Ionite mine into storage facilities, we solved the issue of resource storage once and for all. It seems that the mine itself has long dried up and is nothing more than a vast network of caves. Nevertheless, if necessary, we will strengthen the vaults of the caves, isolate underground water and increase the warehouse capacity, and it will be necessary, given that further development of the base will require significant resources.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:4:description
Reward: What luck, that the territory of the Osterberg fortress has extensive oil reserves. Constructed oil rigs will provide us with fuel - an extremely necessary resource in wartime. This "black gold" is so valued for a reason, thanks to it we will refuel walking machines and ensure the transfer of troops to the front line in time. In addition, our construction machines require fuel for work. Without the necessary refueling - the whole construction will stop. Construction of the second, and in the future - third oil rig should not be delayed. Our engineers also developed plans to improve and optimize production - upgrading the oil rigs will allow even costly operations. The Dominion shall shudder under the power of our war machines!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:5:description
Reward: Iron Empire was built with blood and sweat of young brave men, the foundations of our army. Without a constant inflow of new recruits, the machine of war simply stalls. In these difficult times it is easy to forget about the value of human life, but the situation forces you to sacrifice dozens, and sometimes even hundreds of soldiers to achieve the task. Therefore, it is necessary to ensure the conditions for the restoration of reserves in the first place. Residential quarters around the fortress will serve as a shelter for wives and children, and in short intervals between the battles - the soldiers will be able to stay with their families. Recruits are the future of our army and the entire Iron Empire. If we are not able to defeat the Dominion by force, we will crush it with the quantity.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:6:description
Reward: For years, resistance fought the guerrilla war, methodically and regularly destroying one Dominion patrol after another, raiding food convoys and organizing sabotage in factories and warehouses. Thus, each raid struck not only on the Dominion's armed forces, but also on its welfare. In each successful raid, our fighters extracted the Chests with valuable materials, which the Resistance needed so much. Experience of guerrilla warfare shows that the chests can contain: Resources, Reagents, Elements of collections, Manuals, Keys, Gold, City plans, Craft items. With the capture of Osterberg nothing has changed: if we want to develop, we need to intercept as many chests from the enemy as possible, this will make us stronger, and the enemy weaker.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:7:description
Reward: Weapons, bullets, shells, explosives - without this equipment modern military operations are impossible. With a constant inflow of raw materials, our armourers supply soldiers with advanced weapons and other equipment, which help to bring the enemies of the Empire to their knees. The introduction of innovations, as well as the best models of firearms and siege weapons, helps fighters to rely less on luck, take fewer unnecessary risks and be more in control over the situation around. This is the main thing in the thick of the battle. Weapon factories - the basis of the military machine of the Empire. In a protracted war, when each bullet and each rifle is valued, we will equip soldiers with the armament necessary to accomplish the task. The weapon volley has long been music for our soldiers. So this symphony will not abate until the victory over the Dominion!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:8:description
Reward: Infantry is the backbone of the army, and I sadly recall the times of the Empire, when the infantry were brilliantly trained, equipped with the latest technology and severely disciplined. Then the soldiers were ready for any task assigned to them, and any operation was theirs. But those times have passed, and we had to reconcile ourselves to a new reality, in which infantry is formed from civilians, equipped on a residual principle and trained in a critical deadline. Naturally, this does not diminish the efforts and heroism of the fighters who are making their unbearable contribution to overthrowing the bloody regime of the Dominion. As the Commander of the rising Empire, I feel responsible for the life of each soldier who died under my command, and therefore I will try to teach them in the best possible way.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:9:description
Reward: "Knowledge is a dangerous tool that can give great strength, but  also destroy you.The history won't let you lie: The Iron Empire believed that an army of walking machines would protect them from any enemy and eventually lost the war to the Dominion which received the unprecedented power of the occult knowledge at the cost of turning the inhabitants into the cold-hearted possessed people. Today we have one chance to win and we have no right to make mistakes of our predecessors. Building of the Academy and the conduct of scientific research in the fields of Genetics, Mechanics, Occultism and Tesla Energy will enable us to create a powerful army capable of destroying any enemy". I have nothing to add to this scientists' note, commander. That's why they are scientists, so that they could express their thoughts clearly and understandable.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:10:description
Reward: I had the honor to teach him when he was a rookie, commander. He is the hero of the Iron Empire from the time of its existence until the downfall. He took part in the resistance after that. Thanks to his leadership qualities, he commands respect and devotion to the brothers in arms. Besides, he's a great fighter who repeatedly proved his valor on the battlefield. He is able to destroy entire enemy troops with his own hands. Even the most experienced veterans of our army take the example of him and rookies dream of being like him. You can totally rely on him, commander. It's simply impossible to find a person more devoted to our cause.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:11:description
Reward: No matter how professional the soldier is, he won't do anything if his gun stalled and the bayonet is only fits for opening cans. freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1453:description
Reward: One of the main tasks of the Rising Empire, besides overthrowing the Dominion regime, is taking care of the civilians. After all, this is what sets us apart from the enemy. We received a distress signal from the people of Westfolk and must respond.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1454:description
Reward: Local people say that they face constant raids and kidnappings on the part of the "Black murderers". We don't know who they are for now, we have met only the Dominion patrols on our way.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1455:description
Reward: Despite the extremely contradictory testimony of residents, the problem seems to be real. We see half-deserted villages, tortured people, gallows, and sometimes even piles of corpses around us. Perhaps we should go further into the Valley, maybe we'll find answers to the questions that interest us there.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1456:description
Reward: Surprisingly, since the time of our last visit, the Valley at the Richard's pass has changed noticeably. It seems that someone really has settled here and started active work on exploitation of the local population for the extraction of useful materials and the excavation of relic artifacts.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1457:description
Reward: It turned out that "Black murderers" are not a figment of the imagination of local residents and not even a simple band of renegades, but a well-organized and armed group. We need to figure out who they are, and how they managed to capture the Valley without unnecessary noise, and more importantly, why.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1458:description
Reward: The goals and positioning of the grouping found in the Valley are not yet clear to us. We need to clarify these points in the shortest possible time, but first of all - to stop the exploitation of civilians and to release the prisoners.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1459:description
Reward: We have entered the open confrontation phase, which will force the enemy to draw officers to our location, and then, capturing the prisoner, we will finally put an end to the prolonged investigation, and find out who is behind the iron mask.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1460:description
Reward: Our efforts was crowned with success and we managed to capture the prisoner. We learned a little: basically, that "black murderers" are directly related to the Dominion and the location of an informant who has the information we need in the right amount. Come forward. Today we will get answers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1461:description
Reward: Interrogation of the prisoner showed that we are confronted by the Old Reich fighters - the ruling elite of the Dominion in pre-war times. At the time, differences between the Chancellor and the Supreme Hierarch of the Dark Gods led to the overthrow of that regime and the formation of a totalitarian theocracy.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1462:description
Reward: It may seem that the regime of the Old Reich has also become a hostage of the situation and has every reason to become our ally, but this is not so. It was they who gave the order for the development of the Monolith and founded the Church of the Dark Gods. They are ruthless killers, ready for any sacrifice in the search for the secret of eternal life.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1463:description
Reward: Unmasking the enemy ignited a spark of retribution in the hearts and eyes of our fighters. They rightfully blame the leaders of the Old Reich in all their misfortunes and sufferings and they are not far from the truth in their judgments.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1464:description
Reward: Judging by the reactions of the prisoners during the interrogations, it can be assumed that the representatives of the Reich, engaged in their excavations, missed the moment of the beginning of the revival of the Empire, and therefore they accept us as ordinary rebels and are absolutely sure of their superiority. Well, this will play a cruel joke on them.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1465:description
Reward: Another fact that "black murderers" should see is the relief of the valley, here is only one entrance and one exit. And it is already controlled by our troops. The history of the Old Reich will soon come to an end in the fire of righteous vengeance.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1466:description
Reward: After spending a lot of time in the interrogation room, it became known that the Reich fighters were combing the valley in search of the Tower of the Alchemist - Rearden Winterstein - the legendary personality of the past. Having seized the tower, we'll kick the beehive.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1467:description
Reward: Unfortunately, one desire to destroy the Reich is not enough. In the end, they are experienced fighters, and therefore will have to show considerable tactical ingenuity in order to carry out the task, while bearing minimal losses.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1468:description
Reward: With each liquidated patrol, with every destroyed field headquarters and freed prisoners, the degree of heat is inexorably increasing, rates are rising, and the Reich fighters are fighting more and more desperately. Perhaps they already understand that they are doomed.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1469:description
Reward: Now, the whole perimeter of the valley will be under our control. Run "black" nowhere. We put a noose around the neck of global evil and are ready to tighten it without superfluity of conscience. It's only a matter of time.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1470:description
Reward: "... In the name of the Rising Empire, we find the organization known as the "Old Reich" guilty of crimes against humanity and sentence it to oblivion, and all members of this organization to death. The verdict will be carried out immediately... "

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1471:description
Reward: We are close to the goal. The headquarters of the Old Reich can already be seen in the sight of a sniper rifle, nevertheless all the remaining forces of the "black murderers" are concentrated on the approaches to it. They are literally cornered. We will not back down for anything, and there's simply no place for them to retreat. The battle will be hot.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1472:description
Reward: Today's battle will go down in history as "The overthrow of the Old Reich regime." We will remember it as a bloodbath on the blazing lands in the heart of the Richter Valley - as a day when the Dominion Hydra lost one of its many heads.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1474:description
Reward: Only the best graduates of the military academies was accepted in the personal guard of the Chancellor of the Old Reich, suitable for strict selection criteria. Each guardsman costs ten, and sometimes even hundreds of ordinary fighters.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1476:description
Reward: Destroyers - elite fighters from the Guard of the Old Reich. Their whole life boils down to a single goal: the Chancellor's service and the impeccable fulfillment of any of his orders.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1478:description
Reward: Dominion reapers are only a frivolous parody of those who could become reapers at the times of the Old Reich. Rigid psychological and physical modifications, genetic engineering and grueling training - that was the basis of the best of the Chancellor's Guard.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1480:description
Reward: The most dangerous and contradictory tasks were carried out by elite operatives - assassins who answered directly to the Chancellor of the Old Reich. Their targets rarely survived until the second shot.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1482:description
Reward: Discipline and obedience are the basis of the Old Reich and were valued by the Chancellor above all else. Those who did not agree with such a policy were quickly brought to life with the help of the mechanized fist of the Guard.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:1483:description
Reward: The Old Reich commanding officers underestimated the technology of landing troops to the very heart of the battle, until they lost multiple sector to the enemy drop capsules. Now, landings are used even in the most trivial combat missions

Reward: The years of intense work of the "Ardheim" factories in the Arber delta have completely drained the valley, depleted mineral resources and created a sinister anthropogenic landscape that has become the refuge of countless marauding gangs driven into the wasteland by the Dominion patrols and the Empire forces.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2373:description
Reward: Obtained for the successful completion of the missions of the campaign "Expulsion". By typing the required number of stars, you can get a reward.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2378:description
Reward: To succeed in our mission, we need to understand the laws of the wasteland that destroyed some and exalted others. For this, it seems, we will have to adopt the experience of local inhabitants who are probably already aware of our immediate arrival

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2383:description
Reward: No wonder that wastelands not the most hospitable place of the continent, and after yesterday's ruin of one of the marauders border camps, can become intolerable. Now, every marauder from here and up to the Devil ridge knows about our arrival and polishes that heap of scrap metal, which they call rifles.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2388:description
Reward: The main problem of warfare in the Wasteland is the lack of established ways of supplying and regular delivery of ammunition, fuel and food to front-rank troops. Nevertheless, the Wasteland are rich in factories and warehouses with the "legacy" of Ardheim company, which is quite capable of meeting our needs.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2393:description
Reward: Marauders ambush us all the time since we invaded the Wasteland. We have to fight for every dune or abandoned factory, and every fight is a loss. But not in vain. We were manage to find out that not all marauders are under the influence of mutagen. But only members of the so-called "Triad" - a criminal grouping consisting of three gangs, one of them is the main and control other two.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2398:description
Reward: Due to the structure of the "Triad" the mutagen of better quality goes to members of the predominant gang, the rest is distributed among the other three gangs according to the principle of decreasing quality. Thus, the Bloody Barkhan gang, the camp of which was discovered during yesterday’s raid, receives the lowest grade mutagen, which makes its destruction our priority target.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2403:description
Reward: This bomb has caused scientists to question the undeniable usefulness of progress. After destroying all life with a gruesome explosion, it covers the affected area with a cloud of mustard gas. Not even grass could grow on that area for years.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2404:description
Reward: Rapid deployment of the minefield will stop even the most impetuous and strong infantry of the enemy.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2406:description
Reward: Today we have to face a fierce battle: blood and sand will become one, Bloody Barkhan gang will cease to exist, and the wastelands will become a slightly safer place. After so many weeks of wandering in the sand blindly, we came to the trail of "mutagenic crumbs", which will lead to the elimination of the marauding threat once and for all.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2411:description
Reward: Researching of the Wasteland along the coast has payed off, although this was the path of least resistance: we focused on the area along the Arber river, and the concentration of marauders in the region was bearable. But now, following the route of the mutagen delivery, we're going to the heart of the deadly wastelands, in search of the band "Sand Snakes" camp.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2412:description
Reward: Sand Snakes couldn't ignore our arrival to the Wasteland. The scouts has reported that their bands were waiting near the next sand dune. I bet they underestimate our strength. Or overestimate their own.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2413:title
Reward: With kind word and a gun

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2413:description
Reward: After a “productive” conversation, the marauders decided that our specialists were quite pleasant interlocutors. But there is a nuance: the information was obtained in a marauder dialect, which means, it’s all the same that it is encrypted. We haven't got a distinct position and strength of marauder forces, which means that we have to march dozens of kilometers across the sand dunes under the scorching desert sun in search of a hypothetical base.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2414:description
Reward: The marauder way of life never contributed to a clear statement of thoughts. According to the result of the interrogation, the number of their forces varies from "hella lot" to "hella little" and our linguists assume this by analogs of “a couple of thousand” and “up to a hundred”. In any case, the marauders have opened seasons and it is yet to confirm or refute this hypothesis in practice.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2415:description
Reward: Thick walls and hermetic windows of this factory were supposed to protect it from the water pressure, but when the “Ardheim” was hiding it at the bottom of the river and they couldn’t even imagine that it would also protect it from the desert heat. We have to do our best. According to the reports we received earlier, their leader is the former imperial military Major Brick. If mutagen and life among marauders didn't deprive him of his former professionalism completely than this fight can cost us dearly.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2416:description
Reward: Two hydra heads are cut off. Only one remained, the most dangerous one, called "Scorpions of the Wasteland". This band considered the strongest of the Triad for a good reason. The monopoly of the best quality mutagen turns the members of this band into a destruction machines. Of course, reaching it is not the most trivial task, but we are on the right track.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2417:description
Reward: The Wasteland is not a hospitable place and the "Scorpions" will try to make our stay here as unpleasant as possible. We have already stumbled upon their ambushes and our scouts report that the next one is waiting for us. Today desert hyenas will have a feast and marauders will do everything possible to make us main course for them.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2418:description
Reward: A couple of days separates us from the last factory. Razor is not going to let us go there. It seems that his entire army is meeting us. The elite of marauder soldiers led by him. Of course, they can't be compared with our fighters, but we must be extremely careful, because they compensate for the lack of battle training with the physical parameters that they have thanks to the mutagen.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2419:description
Reward: You'd think the gang is crushed and the leader is defeated, so we can relax and give the soldiers a rest, but where did the raiders come from? I can't understand to which gang they belong and why they are in the territory of the "scorpions of wasteland". Anyway, they are unfriendly and the bullets that whistle around our soldiers only confirm this.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2420:description
Reward: Damn it! It might've been possible to say where the factory exactly was, but the years and the terrifying influence of marauders have turned the factory complex into an indiscriminate heap of buildings, small extensions and just mountains of rubbish and garbage. It's simply impossible to say where the main building is located, let alone the entrance.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2421:description
Reward: It's simply impossible, but my eyes don't deceive me - the members of the three bands operate together! Troops of elite fighters of each band rush into battle as if they're absolutely not afraid of death. It’s not the first time I've come across marauders, and there's only one reason for their courage. There is someone whom they fear more than us.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2422:description
Reward: The tools of support will clear our way. I wanted to leave them for the extreme case but the marauders went crazy. Looking at how they attack the united ranks of our soldiers, one would think that in case of retreat, they would face a fate worse than death...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2423:description
Reward: Our troops have broken through the defenses and are going to storm the factory itself. At the head of the marauders is Sledge himself. This person must be exceptionally cruel and dangerous if people are afraid of him more than death. We should end this once and for all. Today, the Wastelands will forget what the Triad is.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2427:description
Reward: An outstanding scientist, concurrently - agent of the Secret Intelligence Service of the Iron Empire, Henry Rosenstein, spent many years working undercover in the center of the research program conducted by the Northern Protectorate. During the events of the "Fall of the Iron Curtain" was urgently extracted.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2428:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2429:description
Reward: Obtained for killing enemies by Special Agent Rosenstein. Gain Experience to increase the hero’s level and get skill points for upgrades.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2430:description
Reward: Implants and bio-modifications make the marauders not to fear for their own lives. This is a key aspect when comes the time to load into a semi-broken capsule and landing into the very thick of the battle.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:2431:description
Reward: Brute force and unbridled fury allowed Hammer to become the head of the band Bloody Barkhan. At the very end of the "Triad's mutagen chain," Hammer's marauders were engaged in patrolling the border zone and committing raids on the Dominion lands.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:13:description
Reward: It's just breathtaking when these machines appear on the battlefield! Mechanisms built exclusively for war with a single purpose of destruction and demolition. Their armor can't be pierced with simple rifles and handguns, so the enemy's infantry is not a threat to them. I'm sure, the scientist who created them was a true soldier in his heart! The tank factory is the place where these giants are produced. Here you can build tank equipment and walking machines. There are also studies being conduct to strengthen these giants. Strengthen the armor, add firepower and the Dark Gods themselves will be powerless against you. Soon a day will come when our tanks will creep along the capitals of the Dominion and the flag of the Iron Empire will stream over Rainstein!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:14:description
Reward: The soldiers whom we train in the fortress are devoted to our cause wholeheartedly but they're not the only ones who want to fight against the accursed Dominion. I allowed myself a little liberty to send the news to my old colleagues and the replenishment will come soon. The real wolves of the war will arrive in the fortress. Veterans, with whom I've completed many campaign during the service to the Empire. The fanatics of the Dark Gods annoyed them a lot and the guys won't calm down until this infection disappears from our lands. Don't worry about the time and resources, because fighters are very experienced, they don't require any training and I will take money from the treasury for their maintenance, so they'll be on a full allowance. They will be dressed, shod and fed. And we'll place them in the Hall of the Elite Legion, because it's a right place for them!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:15:description
Reward: The barrack is one of the most important buildings of the fortress, every soldier starts his training here and even Captain Walker was a rookie and made his fair share of mistakes here. For the greenhorns that recently enlisted as volunteers it'll become a home for the next years. Here the young men learn how to become real soldiers to make the Iron Empire proud of them. Each of them will soon be a stormtrooper, ranger or infantryman. And after that there will be additional trainings which will make them faster and stronger and help them to learn how to handle weapons better. Even cold-hearted Dominions will tremble with fear when they'll see our troops!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:16:description
Reward: After capturing the Osterberg fortress, Karl Gustav repeatedly pointed out to Commander Grant that the Resistance needed to build the Arsenal as soon as possible and start the resonators production.\nHe never was tired of explaining how resonators work: feeding the device with boosted frequency will lead to resonance in the fine structures of the ionite lattice and the formation of the electromagnetic pulse which is needed for detonating the capsule of the large-caliber shells. This means that resonators are very important for creating or upgrading the support shells. Even if your artillery itself is powerful, accurate and has a long-range, it remains just a pile of metal without shells. Don't forget that, commander.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:17:description
Reward: I don't know about the others but I feel much calmer when I know that we are covered by artillery. After all, artillery and retreat can cover us and destroy the enemy from a safe distance. For example, if the enemy dug in somewhere or  the detachment has entered the battle and bears losses, the healing chemistry can really help us. It's much easier when you have supporting tools. The artillery factory developes improvements for our guns. They can invent some kind of chemistry to upgrade the explosive force. They can make cuts on the barrel so that the shell could fly more accurately or attach the mechanism to the gun to make it more convenient to charge. Build this factory, commander, and let the Dominions know that not only the rain can fall from the sky.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:18:description
Reward: It scares me to think that moving one figure on this map can destroy cities and take thousands of lives in the reality. It's a map of the world, commander. You decide where to put forward your soldiers and who will be attacked by troops. You determine what forces need to be sent to the operation and what support will be allocated to them. It depends only on your decisions how many of our soldiers will return to their homes today and how many will remain on the battlefield forever. It's a heavy burden, commander, but we believe that only you can destroy the Dominion and clean our lands from this infection!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:19:description
Reward: The most complicated mechanism can't work even if the smallest gear is broken. Even though tanks and walking machines are not the most complicated mechanisms, the flywheel is also not just a simple gear. The Assembly workshop produces flywheels. It's a very important part which makes machinery move. First, the metal of the required quality is brought here from the foundry, melted and poured into molds. After cooling, the stock of the future flywheel is removed and processed manually to bring it to the specified parameters. At the end, this billet is hardened and processed with a special composition to impart strength and hardness. The scientists tried to explain what this composition was made of, but I didn't understand anything except the words "first we mix". Commander, make sure that the army doesn't need anything and all units will go like clockwork.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:20:description
Reward: In this room subordinates report to you about important events in the world and changes in the alignment of enemy forces. The map on this table is your tool in this war and it play a very significant role. Our whole army is blind without your instructions. This map is a sight that will enable our forces to strike accurately at the target and crush the enemy. Show your tactical genius, commander, and wipe the enemy off the face of the earth!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3481:description
Reward: The location of the first stone of the eclipse, the seal of Begeroth, the God of hatred and anger is the Plateau of Lorraine, where the cultists take prisoners to perform the ritual. There are many fanatics and they dug in at a height. Our only advantage is the element of surprise. Let's go!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3482:description
Reward: The first stone was destroyed, but it was was our lead in the search for cultists. There is no time for field reconnaissance and deployment of headquarters. If we want to find the remaining three stones and interrupt the ritual, find allies among the locals. There is a transportation point for cultists not far from here, where the prisoners are awaiting shipment to the sites of rituals. We'll free the prisoners and get the required information.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3483:description
Reward: Several of the liberated people introduced themselves as members of the Order of the Crimson Sunset, a militarized group that vowed to stop the invasion of the Dark Gods into our world and destroy the Cult of the Four Eclipses at any cost. The soldier seemed even more fanatic than the cultists after the conversation. They indicated the location of the second ritual and the stone linked with it, the Claw of Sagash, the God of suffering and pain.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3484:description
Reward: The cultists are becoming more and more violent with each interrupted ritual. The Claw of Sagash is destroyed, but the location of the third stone remains unknown. Tarx, the deputy head of the Order of Crimson Sunset and the only one who knows the venue of the ritual, was ambushed at the Isthmus. He is held by cultists in a fortified camp nearby. We have to release him.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3485:description
Reward: Commander, it's a trap! Trax is dead, the cultists have taken our soldiers in a ring and are completing preparations to storm our fortifications. Captain Walker suggested a bold plan to break the cordon, perhaps one of the most ambitious and risky plans I've ever heard. If it works, the maneuver will go down in history forever. If it fails, we will all soon be begging the Dark Gods for mercy.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3486:description
Reward: The search continues. We have miraculously escaped a crushing defeat, but haven't achieved our goal yet. The archivist of the order tells about the ancient temple of the God Khignon, the ruler of all occult magic. There may be information about the site of the ritual with the stone Khignon in the dungeons of the temple. Attacking the cultists in their lair is extremely dangerous, but we have no choice.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3487:description
Reward: The Pass of the Dead is the only obstacle on the way to the Eye of Khignon, the third stone of the eclipse. Unfortunately, the cultists also know about it and have already strengthened themselves on the slopes. If we concede now, we won't be able to stop the coming of the Dark Gods. Inquisitors of the Order of Crimson Sunset have agreed to set out at the point of attack. Our task is to cover the rear and break through the defense of the cultists. All or nothing.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3488:description
Reward: The Eye of Khignon is considered by the cultists to be the source of all occult magic. The fanatics will die rather than destroy it. The inquisitors suffered serious losses during the storming of the Pass of the Dead and won't be able to fight with us side by side, but they have enough soldiers to covertly enter into the place of the ritual. As a result, we have to attract the attention of every cultist in the district.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3490:title
Reward: …And the living will envy the dead

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3490:description
Reward: The stone was destroyed, but our soldiers have coped with the task too well. Every fanatic in the district is chasing us now. There's nowhere to run, the ridge has cut off the path of retreat. The only solution is to dig in and wait for reinforcements from the order. And if they won't be on time, then we'll take a dozen cultists for every lost soldier!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3491:description
Reward: Order of Crimson Dawn have arrived in time, which means the battle is not over yet. The scouts have noticed a violet flash in the sky and immediately after it a ray of light pointing somewhere on the Orvel Rupture. We can only hope that the location of the last stone is right there. The fierce resistance of the cultists, entrenched at the approaches to the Rupture will be confirmation of it.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3492:description
Reward: The path to the Orvel Rupture is clear. The ritual is almost over, which means that the border between the worlds has weakened. If you don't immediately destroy the last stone, the Crown of Zaurus, the Supreme God of Darkness, nothing will save us. I have some good news, though. The Order of the Crimson Sunset has received reinforcements and is ready to storm. While they are attacking in the forehead, we'll make our way to the rear and destroy the stone.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3494:description
Reward: The ordinary cultists who value the will of the Dark Gods more than their own lives. The fanatics are equipped with everything required to protect their brothers and completely destroy those who refuse to recognize the greatness of the Dark Pantheon.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3496:description
Reward: There's nothing better than the shrill screech of a person whose skin is being cut off for Sagasha. Vigilantes have well learned the preferences of their God and are ready to prepare torture for their enemies which will force them to beg for death

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3498:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3500:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3502:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3504:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3506:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3508:description

Reward:
Having received the distress signal of the Westfolk residents, no one could have imagined that in the valley of Richard we would meet the pre-war government of the Crimson Dominion, sunk into oblivion many years ago. 
Even before the occult wars, the Old Reich was obsessed with the search for immortality, and after the coup d'état, nothing has changed. Having lost everything, the "reichs" concentrated their efforts on achieving the cherished goal, which led them to the valley of Richard, where, according to legends, was the altar of Rearden Winterstein, the mysterious personality of pre-war times. 
During "Overthrow" Operation, we managed to repel the tower from the enemy, to conduct its full inspection and inventory. Of course, there were no artifacts that bestowed immortality, but potions, books, recipes, formulas and reports were present in large numbers. 
Guided by the found drawings, we erected an exact copy of the tower in the Osterberg fortress, later filled with equipment borrowed from Mr. Winterstein. Today, the greatest minds of the Resistance are engaged in studying the heritage of the great alchemist, conducting experiments on occult artifacts and developing the physiology of fighters in the name of victory over the Crimson Dominion! Demonstrate your tactical genius, Commander, and wipe him off the face of the earth!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1355:description

This is a great opportunity, because our scientists have just reached the final stage of testing a new type of mutagen. freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3972:description
Reward: Commander! Alarm! Critical situation! Apparently, the enemy forces managed to slip past our patrols unnoticed. They have already destroyed one of our strongholds. We have to urgently intercept them before they do more damage.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3974:description
Reward: We haven't got any useful information from the possessed prisoner. He was just laughing madly and shouting that his master would destroy us and that we will be betrayed by an ally, so they will watch it. We recognized these possessed, they are from the troops that went on a mission with Commander Grant. I don't want to bury him yet, but we'll prepare for the worst.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3975:description
Reward: Commander, recent allies have arrived. Order of the Crimson Sunset wants to talk to you. They look like they were fighting a heavy battle. Apparently, we are not the only target of the possessed. Anyway, no one knows these occult things better than them. Maybe they can explain what's happening. We have hurry up, the enemy is on their tail.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3976:description
Reward: Commander, it is clear that one of the rituals we interrupted has borne fruit. Some creatures were able to break into our world and, taking advantage of the fact that the border between the worlds became thinner, possessed Commander Grant. Now we can't say for sure whether he can be saved or not. To do that, we need access to the Order's library. We need to create a free pass to our allies - they will look for information and by our arrival they will be able to provide answers to all questions that interest us.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3977:description
Reward: Commander, we have gathered our forces and it's time to go to the fortress of the Order of the Crimson Sunset. There we'll receive information about whether it's possible to save Grant or we have lost our ally forever. Let's get rid of the those remnants of the possessed and go!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3978:description
Reward: Grant may have become possessed, but he still has his skills and intelligence! I hear volleys of guns, the possessed are attacking the fortress. This is the only place where we can get the information on how to defeat them. We have to speed up, Commander. We can't lose so many comrades at one time.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3979:description
Reward: We were right! The Order took all the cultists artifacts from the ritual site. According to their information, this scepter can suppress the will of a demon who has possessed a person, and even subordinate him. The only problem is that the carrier has to be as weak as possible, so that the demon's power would be used to support vital functions. We have to practically kill Grant to use the scepter.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3980:description
Reward: Commander, we have problems! The enemy sabotage team has penetrated the vault and attempted to steal the scepter. The warriors of the Order were able to repel the attack, but the enemy has taken part of the scepter! We need to catch up with them urgently before they get to their main forces.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:3981:description
Reward: We were too carried away by the chase, Commander! While we were finishing off the remnants of the sabotage team, Grant has secretly led his troops and suddenly attacked us with all his power. He even lifted the siege from the fortress. Everything will be decided here, Commander. We must not only win, but also save the enemy's life.

Reward: There are not many people who citizens of the Old Monarchy hated more. Punitive troop didn't participate in battles, didn't shed blood on the battlefields. The destruction of those who disagree with the new regime is what they did. The brutality and bloodyness of their methods was terrifying. Those who have seen the massacre were shivering. Punitive troop recruited either sadists or complete sociopaths. Without doubt their leader can be attributed to to the second category. Hiding behind the mask, he carried out thousands of demonstrative executions. Tens of thousands people will forever remember the phrase that accompanied every execution - “Nothing personal, it's just my job.” "Cleaner" is the name that all mothers of the Empire have been using to frighten children for many years. \nWhen the Supreme Hierarch of the Dark Gods overthrew the Old Reich, Cleaner disappeared. Many believe that the followers of the Dark Gods killed him, someone believes that he went underground, like the government of the Old Reich. Others are sure that he went to the East and continued his bloody cleansing there.

Having rejected the name, forgetting the past and not giving a damn about the future, the Disowned one will find out who became the cause of everything, find him, and make him pay for everything.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4229:description
Reward: Commander, we've received disturbing news. We didn't heard back from a distant checkpoint based in the mountains for a long time so we sent an intelligence there. The checkpoint was destroyed, no survivors! But the most disturbing thing is that this checkpoint is accessible only by one bridge, and it could be simply blown up if the enemy appeared. No living creature can get there through the mountains the temperatures are low and the air is too thin.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4230:description
Reward: The investigation confirms that there was a battle at the checkpoint. The strange thing is that there was not a single corpse of attackers left, not even traces of blood. It seems that none of the attackers was injured. It's difficult to say something more specific, as it's extremely difficult to read traces on stone soil. The only thing I can say is that most likely the enemies wore heavy armor, because there were imprints on the ground. Either a person in extra heavy armor or a small walking machine could leave those traces, they are VERY deep.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4231:description
Reward: Commander, another distant checkpoint stopped responding to our messages! We need to gather troops immediately and find out what happened there. Intelligence reports that some strange activity has also began in the Dominion army. Perhaps, we'll face them more than once.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4232:description
Reward: Great, one less problem to worry about! The survived Dominion soldier said that they were sent on a punitive expedition in response to our aggression. Allegedly, we destroyed a couple of their villages... Commander, we've lost contact and intelligence reports that sounds of shots are coming from the checkpoint! We have to hurry up and find out who is attacking our people!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4233:description
Reward: I can't even begin to understand what was that, Commander. These mechanisms... they are much smaller then walking machines and much faster. They attacked the first checkpoint! This explains why there were no traces of blood and enemy corpses! Our intelligence reports that they found someone's footprints. Apparently, there was a witness. We have to catch up with him - we need answers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4234:description
Reward: At least one of them is still moving. Maybe our scientists will be able to tell who created these machines. But I'm sure that the enemy won't let us take a hostage easily. We'd better prepare for the battle.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4235:description
Reward: Well, the robot is delivered to our laboratories, and now we have to organize a serious defense. I'm sure these creatures will be quite determined to take one of their own back, we should prepare for an attack. Scientists ask for at least 9 hours, because this is a complicated mechanism and it's not easy to figure it out.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4236:description
Reward: Commander, things are moving very slowly! Scientists only managed to open the robot's body. They say this is delicate work and it was necessary not to damage any of the internal mechanisms. They need another 6 hours. We need to continue to hold the defenses!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4237:description
Reward: We're making some progress! We were able to determine which of the mechanisms is used for communication. Our specialist needs at least 3 more hours to assemble the locator and adjust it to the desired frequency of signal reception.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4238:description
Reward: Finally everything is ready, Commander! The locator is functioning and we can already from where the robots receive the signal. Apparently, the enemy understood it and ceased the fire.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4239:description
Reward: We've cleared the territory, so our scientists are not in danger anymore. The device is in our hands, the base is safe. I think it's time for us to pay a return visit!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4240:description
Reward: Damn, we should've known that they won't just leave us alone. These robots attack from unexpected sides. Metal creatures don't care about weather conditions and route complexity. The steel doesn't know fatigue and they don't need to breathe.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4241:description
Reward: The enemy estimated the situation and the robots have changed tactics. Now instead of just attacking us from the march, they set up ambushes. We have to strengthen the front watch.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4242:description
Reward: Unbelievable! They attacked us from the rocks! A lizard couldn't climb these steep slopes, but they fell on us like an avalanche of steel and gunpowder!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4243:description
Reward: Great, robots are making roadblocks now! They're building barricades and installing heavy guns. It seems like if someone is using all methods of warfare. As if he's turning over the pages of manual and testing options...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4244:description
Reward: Locator indicates that we are no more than a kilometer away from the target. The number of these mechanisms is just terrifying, but we need to find out where they came from and why they're attacking. I think we have to prepare for the decisive battle. Moreover, intelligence reports about new robot, significantly different from the others, armed with an axe and a shield.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4245:description
Reward: Commander, the second strike group reports that the robots with an axe attacked them, slaughtered almost all of our figthers and destroyed the "Hammer" walking machine in a couple of minutes. We need to intervene right now, otherwise our people will be wiped out.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4543:description
Reward: Rosenstein had been living in the Northern Protectorate for a long time. After that the spy arrived home and started living the normal life. Sometimes he gets nostalgic on holidays and pulls out a warm raincoat with boots from a dusty box. It's a uniform he got during the assignment in the Protectorate.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4544:description
Reward: Commander, we've received alarming news. There was no news from a distant roadblock based in the mountains for a long time and we sent intelligence there. It was destroyed. The problem is that there was only one bridge, and they would have simply blown it up and asked for help when enemy appeared. No living creature can get there through the mountains the temperatures are low and the air is rarefied.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4545:description
Reward: The investigation confirms that there was a fight at the checkpoint. It's strange that not a single corpse of the attackers was left, not even blood stains. One gets the impression that none of the attackers was hurt. It is difficult to say something more specific as the traces on stone soil are very poor. I can only say one thing - most likely the enemies were in heavy armor - there were imprints on the ground. They could be left either by a person in extra heavy armor or a small walker - they are VERY deep.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4546:description
Reward: Commander, another distant roadblock stopped responding to our requests. We have to urgently assemble troops and see what happened. The incomprehensible activity has also began in the Dominion army. Perhaps, we'll face them more than once.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4547:description
Reward: We've figured everything out here. Survived Dominion soldier has said that they were sent on a punitive expedition in response to our aggression. Allegedly, we destroyed a couple of their villages... Commander, we've lost contact and intelligence reports that the sounds of battle can be head from the roadblock. We have to hurry up and find out who is attacking our people!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4548:description
Reward: I can’t even presume what was that, Commander. These mechanisms... they are much smaller then walking machines and much more mobile. They attacked the first roadblock! This explains why there are no blood traces and enemy corpses! Our scouts report that they have found traces of the observer. Someone witnessed the attack. We have to catch up with him - we need answers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4549:description
Reward: At least one of them is still moving. Maybe our scientists will be able to tell who created of these machines. But it seems to me that they won't let us go with him. We'd better preparing for battle.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4550:description
Reward: Commander, things are moving very slowly! Scientists have only opened the body of the robot. They say this is delicate work and it was necessary not to damage any of the internal mechanisms. They need 6 hours more. We rely on you, Commander!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4551:description
Reward: Locator indicates that we are no more than a kilometer away from the target. The number of these mechanisms is just terrifying, but we need to find out where they came from anf why they attack our people. I think we have to prepare for a decisive battle. Moreover, scouts report on the appearance of a new robot, which is significantly different from the others. He is armed with an axe and a shield.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4552:description
Reward: Our troops have finally united, Commander. Robot with an ax nowhere to be seen. Most likely he turned the tide of battle here and withdrew to his position again. In any case, we have only one option - attack!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4741:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4742:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4743:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4744:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4745:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4746:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4747:description
Reward: I knew that we can't ignore the intelligence! With the help of an improvised drilling rig, the machines could dig a tunnel as big as several Northern Gates. We can't ignore this device. Let's destroy it.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4748:description
Reward: The destruction of the installation announce your presence louder than if we had come and asked to let us in. We have to operate the old-fashioned way... Troops, get ready for an offensive!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4749:description
Reward: Production installations are still working, and someone has launched the assembly of machines that the Protectorate had an intend to do. We have to stop the operation of the complex. It's hard to imagine how many machines could be produced mechanically over the years.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4750:description
Reward: Finally! Seeing the sky is much nicer than having tons of stone hanging above. I would've never thought that northern snowstorms could bring me so much happiness. Well, we should've prepared that they would meet us. Let's fight!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4751:description
Reward: If someone haven't attacked the machines from the rear, we would be killed by now. I want to know who helped us. There really were people behind the gates?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4752:description
Reward: According to the commander of the survivors troop, there had been up to a thousand people in the valley all the time. When the gates closed, they lost all chances to get out of the valley and were forced to survive here.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4753:description
Reward: The tunnels are clean, so people trapped in the valley have a chance to escape. We have to provide them with a safe passage during the evacuation.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4754:description
Reward: Commander, if we use the information provided us by Bjorg Ansgarson, we will get to the assembly line quicker. Therefore, we'll avoid unnecessary clashes and save energy for the main battle.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4755:description
Reward: We are approaching the assembly line, Commander. At this stage the enemy resistance will be the most violent. This is his last chance to defend the production, and he understands this. All his reserves probably will be against us.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4756:description
Reward: Finally, the assembly line is destroyed and the plant doesn't function anymore. We just have to remove machine remnants so that people who live nearby could breathe a sigh of relief.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4757:description
Reward: I think I jumped to conclusions, Commander. The most important battle is ahead. The order to everybody is to regroup and use the remaining stimulants. We don't know the enemy forces we have to prepare ourselves for the worst.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4758:description
Reward: The resistance of the machines doesn't get less stronger. Apparently, they've prepared part of the forces to protect this object. I think we need to ask locals for help. Let's strike together.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4759:description
Reward: These mechanisms should no longer cause problems to anyone. It'll be a hard fight. Perhaps some of us won't return home. But we know that the peace of our citizens and peace in the Empire сome first.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4760:description
Reward: Special support troops are trained at the Academy, reinforcing the tactical superiority of the allied forces on the battlefield.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4761:description
Reward: This robot series is produced in the largest quantities and are used as ordinary infantry. Light defense, not the best weapons. Their power lies in quantity and lack of fear.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4762:description
Reward: In contrast to the "LK-48" model, this series is equipped with a more durable body and a much faster weapon. Lower manipulators are reinforced, which gives them the opportunity to pick up a much greater speed.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4763:description
Reward: The most massive series of Klaus robots, and the most destructive one. Special alloy armor, powerful howitzers. Few could survive after contacting with them to share the experience.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4765:description
Reward: In contrast to the "LK-48" model, this series is equipped with a more durable body and a much faster weapon. Lower manipulators are reinforced, which gives them the opportunity to pick up a much greater speed.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4766:description

So it was until someone else's will took possession of them and did not put a weapon in their hands. With the same indifference with which they crushed a stone earlier, they destroy any living thing.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4767:description
Reward: An incredibly deft model of a combat machine capable of disguising himself to any environment and armed with long-range weapons. The model uses its combat skills as efficiently as possible.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4768:description
Reward: Protectorate couldn't build even one of these robots and no one had time to give them the names. The surviving inhabitants of the valley called them "big guys" because of their supernatural vitality and phenomenal power.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4769:description
Reward: These robots caused a lot of problems to people. Camouflage cloaks hid them against the gray rocks, covered with snow, and their mechanical nature allowed them to stand still all day long. They were gathering information and could attack unexpectedly.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4770:description
Reward: Unlike the lighter model "M", these mechanisms were used for strong rock. Their circular saws could plunge into the rock, excavating tunnels in it. Now the sound of the saw brings horror and nightmares to the surviving people.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4774:description
Reward: Sergeants lead stormtroopers into battle. Their leadership skills increase the survivability of troops on the battlefield.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4776:description
Reward: Imperial Warrior specializes in tactical operations. He directs the fire of the allied troops and increases their combat effectiveness.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1447:description
Reward: Commander! The recent battle with the Klaus bots reminded us of another similar threat. No news was heard from the former Protectorate lands. It's no secret that there are machines behind the gates, which can be several times more dangerous than the creations of a mad engineer. I believe, we should explore the area near the gate.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1449:description
Reward: 11: I believe, Commander, politeness is not the only reason you came here. I've heard, you destroyed a couple of robots that attacked people near the "Dump" zone. I can assure you that they have nothing to do with our machines. They are only our problem within the valley. 4: Commander in no way doubts your competence, but he is obliged to control such a threat. 11: As you wish, but I advise you to be careful. Some people think that the gate should be closed and those who are behind the gates should not be bothered. But since you are so determined, I can't let you go there by yourself. My "Ice Devils" will go with you.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4797:description
Reward: Those who were not lucky enough to get close to big gangs, got a second chance. Resistance always needs warriors, and residents of wastelands always need a mutagen. It'd be hard to come up with more mutually beneficial cooperation.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4798:description
Reward: Giants stuffed with mutagens capable of knocking down the “Hammer” walking machine is a new product of the Resistance experiments for mutually beneficial cooperation with the inhabitants of the wastelands. The first one knocked out the door of the laboratory and used it instead of a shield until it was calmed down. The rest of the giants also liked the idea of "equipment" and now Mutants always use shields in battles.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1461:description
Reward: 12: I am glad to welcome you, Commander. We didn't even hope that anyone would remember about us. We noticed that you are in a quandary and decided to intervene. Let me introduce myself, Leeroy Jackson at your service. I had been supervising the training of infantry corps cadets before it all started. I had the greatest combat experience amongst those who remained, so I was chosen as the commander. Of course, now, anyone who survived can be called a veteran... \n4: Remaining? We thought that all the survivors were evacuated from the valley. Sure, there are no such thing as perfect operation, but you want to say that there are many of you here?! \n11: I am responsible for more than four hundred people. Initially, there were about a thousand or more of us, but harsh weather conditions and machines are merciless...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1463:description
Reward: Commander, the path is clear, but the enemy will definitely try to prevent our wounded soldiers from leaving the valley. You have a chance to return the favor. Cover the withdrawal of my soldiers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4801:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4802:description
Reward: Attempts to force the mutants to fight in big groups were unsuccessful. Their desire to kill each other was above the need to destroy the enemy. The first success that was achieved is to act in a pair in exchange for mutagen for the survival of a partner.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4803:description
Reward: The best result of the interaction of the Mutants, training which allowed to rally them into a group capable of causing significant damage and optimal for elimination, in case of disobedience.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:4804:description
Reward: It's an honor for the ordinary citizen to serve in the infantry of the New Order. Each soldier will gladly give his life at the first order of the commander. The will and principles of the "Northern wolves" are strong and unshakable, just like the centenary glaciers of their homeland.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1466:description
Reward: Commander, you saved my people and my duty is to help you. I also have personal motives: I had been hiding in this valley for a dozen years and I'm not going to miss the opportunity to kick these pieces of iron in the ass! I will show you a shortcut to the plant and main joints that need to be destroyed.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1469:description
Reward: 12: Commander, I'm afraid it's too soon to celebrate. You don't think that the machines just went out of control and tried to kill everybody, right? It all started after our miners dug out a unique lump of ionite exchanger. 4: Stone is the reason of the uprising? What is it... 12: Don't ask me what is it, I am a warrior, not a geologist, but our big heads were running around shouting about how rare this thing is. They took it to the farthest part of the valley to explore. The first batch of crazy machines came from there... 4: How do you know that the problem is there? 12: Only one scientist got out of there. He mumbled something about the "ancient horror" and that "the punishment is coming". We couldn't question him closely but he told that somethig so... ancient was in that lump that it remembered the times when the gods were walking among the people. And it hates us. In any case, our patrols would definitely notice if such a big thing was removed. It is still there.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: quests:1472:description
Reward: 13: Stupid insects. I have waited thousands of years to tear all your settlements down and destroy your entire race. You, wretched worms,can't stop me. This time the gods won't rescue you. 4: What does “this time” mean, machine? We meet for the first time 12: What cares what it's rambling on. freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5272:description
