freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5273:description
Reward: "We came out of water and went towards scorching guns of coastal fortifications. We were falling, getting up and continued to advance. We didn't see the faces of people shooting at us, but we knew that they weren't enemies" - Lieutenant Corvus

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5274:description
Reward: One of the Dominion posts which they use to supply their troops throughout the country.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5275:description
Reward: This is a fortified bunker, guarded by the Old Reich troops. I'm sure that this is one of their secret warehouses, which they have built all over the country.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5276:description
Reward: Reconnaissance told us about a railway depot disguised in a cave. The Old Reich hopes to use it as a backup base, for sure.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5277:description
Reward: The reconnaissance service provided data on the closed and abandoned warehouses of the "Ardheim" company. The entrance is carefully hidden in the rock, so maybe they have not been plundered yet.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5278:title
Reward: Secret Temple of the Dark Gods

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5278:description
Reward: Our agents managed to get the coordinates of the occult temple. It's safely hidden away from civilization. There certainly is a stock of resources and occult literature.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5279:description
Reward: Our reconnaissance troops have found protected warehouses in the depths of the Wasteland. This must be one of the staging points of the Triad which we haven't reached yet.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5280:description
Reward: One of the spare bases of the Imper corps was mentioned in the documentation. They didn't have the opportunity to come back and all the ammunition and resources must still be stored there.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5287:description
Reward: I can't even begin to understand what was that, Commander. These mechanisms... they are much smaller then walking machines and much faster. They attacked the first checkpoint! This explains why there were no traces of blood and enemy corpses! Our intelligence reports that they found someone's footprints. Apparently, there was a witness. We have to catch up with him - we need answers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5288:description
Reward: Well, the robot is delivered to our laboratories, and now we have to organize a serious defense. I'm sure these creatures will be quite determined to take one of their own back, we should prepare for an attack. Scientists ask for at least 9 hours, because this is a complicated mechanism and it's not easy to figure it out.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5289:description
Reward: We're making some progress! We were able to determine which of the mechanisms is used for communication. Our specialist needs at least 3 more hours to assemble the locator and adjust it to the desired frequency of signal reception.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5290:description
Reward: Damn, we should've known that they won't just leave us alone. These robots attack from unexpected sides. Metal creatures don't care about weather conditions and route complexity. The steel doesn't know fatigue and they don't need to breathe.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5291:description
Reward: Locator indicates that we are no more than a kilometer away from the target. The number of these mechanisms is just terrifying, but we need to find out where they came from and why they're attacking. I think we have to prepare for the decisive battle. Moreover, intelligence reports about new robot, significantly different from the others, armed with an axe and a shield.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5292:description
Reward: Commander, things are moving very slowly! Scientists only managed to open the robot's body. They say this is delicate work and it was necessary not to damage any of the internal mechanisms. They need another 6 hours. We need to continue to hold the defenses!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5293:description
Reward: Great, robots are making roadblocks now! They're building barricades and installing heavy guns. It seems like if someone is using all methods of warfare. As if he's turning over the pages of manual and testing options...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5294:description
Reward: The enemy estimated the situation and the robots have changed tactics. Now instead of just attacking us from the march, they set up ambushes. We have to strengthen the front watch.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5295:description
Reward: Thick walls and hermetic windows of this factory were supposed to protect it from the water pressure, but when the “Ardheim” was hiding it at the bottom of the river and they couldn’t even imagine that it would also protect it from the desert heat. We have to do our best. According to the reports we received earlier, their leader is the former imperial military Major Brick. If mutagen and life among marauders didn't deprive him of his former professionalism completely than this fight can cost us dearly.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5296:title
Reward: Blood and Sand for the expedition

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5296:description
Reward: Today we have to face a fierce battle: blood and sand will become one, Bloody Barkhan gang will cease to exist, and the wastelands will become a slightly safer place. After so many weeks of wandering in the sand blindly, we came to the trail of "mutagenic crumbs", which will lead to the elimination of the marauding threat once and for all.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5297:description
Reward: Two hydra heads are cut off. Only one remained, the most dangerous one, called "Scorpions of the Wasteland". This band considered the strongest of the Triad for a good reason. The monopoly of the best quality mutagen turns the members of this band into a destruction machines. Of course, reaching it is not the most trivial task, but we are on the right track.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5298:title
Reward: Power of fear for the expedition

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5298:description
Reward: It's simply impossible, but my eyes don't deceive me - the members of the three bands operate together! Troops of elite fighters of each band rush into battle as if they're absolutely not afraid of death. It’s not the first time I've come across marauders, and there's only one reason for their courage. There is someone whom they fear more than us.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5299:description
Reward: The Wasteland is not a hospitable place and the "Scorpions" will try to make our stay here as unpleasant as possible. We have already stumbled upon their ambushes and our scouts report that the next one is waiting for us. Today desert hyenas will have a feast and marauders will do everything possible to make us main course for them.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5300:title
Reward: Back to battle for the expedition

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5300:description
Reward: You'd think the gang is crushed and the leader is defeated, so we can relax and give the soldiers a rest, but where did the raiders come from? I can't understand to which gang they belong and why they are in the territory of the "scorpions of wasteland". Anyway, they are unfriendly and the bullets that whistle around our soldiers only confirm this.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5301:description
Reward: Damn it! It might've been possible to say where the factory exactly was, but the years and the terrifying influence of marauders have turned the factory complex into an indiscriminate heap of buildings, small extensions and just mountains of rubbish and garbage. It's simply impossible to say where the main building is located, let alone the entrance.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5302:title
Reward: Not a step backwards for the expedition

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5302:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:5304:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: notes:27:description
Reward:
The Resistance found out about raiders from civilians who lived on the border with the Marauder Wastelands. They informed Commander Grant of several savage attacks. However, the Resistance had neither time nor strength to engage in a thorough cleaning of the Wastelands. The problem was delayed by sending soldiers to the plundered settlements who would fight the marauders in the case of repeated attacks.
The first few attacks were repelled with minimal losses. After a brief lull, those who only vaguely resembled marauders, came from the Wastelands. They become unrecognizable because of the mutations. Their appearance had undergone serious changes, mutagen obscured their mind, but at the same time endowed them with superhuman strength and dexterity. Captain Walker also informed about the attack of such creatures in the Fracture peak area.
Over time, we managed to find out that the marauders had changed due to the effect of the ML-751 mutagen, which had been produced in the pre-war time at the factory "Ardheim" No. 23 in the Wastelands.
Commander Grant gave the order - it is imperative to get there and destroy the factore.
The scale of the threat was much bigger than the commander thought. The factory was guarded by the Triad, a criminal group, which included one dominant gang and three ones under control.
"Bloody Barkhan", "Sand Snakes", "Scorpions" - even after each of them was defeated, the remnants of the marauders manged to face the Resistance fighters. They were united by a ruthless leader - Sledge, and they created a united front under his leadership.
When the factory was captured, and Sledge was executed, some of the surviving marauders started serve to the Resistance. They told everything about the Triad creation and functioning. Sledge came across the factory, stuffed himself with mutagen and started to subjugate one gang after another, until all of them they were under his direct control. Reward:
The best burglar of the Western sector. What do we know about him?
He was born in a small town on the outskirts of the Steel Empire shortly before armed uprisings broke out. When spontaneous actions against the Emperor had began, detachments of suppressors arrived from the capital to put an end to them. They made a real massacre and killed most of the rebels, including Ocean's parents.
Changing one profession after another, he clutched at any chance of making a some money. He had joined the local gang at one point, just because he didn't want to die of hunger. A gang of pickpockets taught him their craft and together they had made more than a dozen thefts, until Ocean was caught during one of their sorties.
Nobody knows what happened after. Maybe, he cut a deal with the investigation, bribed the guards or just ran away - but he never got to prison.
Having drawn conclusions from the incident and not wanting to jeopardize his life anymore, he decided to retrain from a pocket thief to an experienced safecracker. He wanted to crack safes and chests obtained by other thieves without leaving his home.
Many years went by after that decision, and now Ocean likes to joke that if he came and offered his services to Commander Grant before the First Occult Wars, Commander would immediately send him to jail. But now, when the Resistance fights with the Crimson Dominion, his skills are truly irreplaceable. After each raid chests with valuable resources are delivered to Österberg for Ocean to open them.

Reward:
Kragg was born in the days when the Old Monarchy was in its prime. He wa a child when he decided to commit his life to a military career. Having enlisted in the service of king, he managed to prove himself during the Old Reich coup. After that the Supreme Chancellor made him a general. However, this didn't mean that Kragg was loyal to the new regime. He demonstrated that by joining the High Hierarch a few years later, when he attempted to seize power and overthrow the ruling elite of the Old Reich.
Military wit, tactical skills and combat experience are Kragg's strong suit, as well as his cruelty and hatred towards the Steel Empire. He went through countless milutary campaigns, planned operations and battles. We can say with certainty that thanks to Marshal Kragg the Crimson Dominion had huge success in the military field and won the Fisrt Occult Wars.
Kragg was impressed by occultists who fought on his side. They were performing occult rituals to turn civilians into possessed ones. Marshal wasn't accustomed to this and tried to avoid such measures, preferring to five orders to loyal fighters, rather than to ones who were obsessed with faith in the Dark Gods. But nevertheless he had to "mobilize" the locals into the ranks of his army. He did it with great disgust, and was dreaming of only one thing - to end the war as soon as possible and to escape from all the horrors that he's seen.
During one of the rituals, he saved Kurt Hagen, the Westphalian gunsmith. Unlike the rest of the captives, he attempted to escape by making a self-cocking revolver from improvised means and killing the adept and several of his minions with accurate shot.
When the Steel Empire fell, Kragg was no longer needed by the Supreme Hierarch, and even began to pose a threat to him, since it was the possibility that he will try to seize power. Instead of bestowing long-awaited peace to the marshal, the Hierarch decided to send him to different parts of the country to complete dangerous tasks. He wanted to get rid of him once and for all. One of the tasks was liquidation of the "Hellish Hounds" gang and it almost became the last one for Kragg. He would die if the Ghost Ranger, who decided that such a talented commander should not die at the hands of a psychopath, didn't save him. Marshal has scar on the right side of his face as a reminder of that terrible day.
When Commander Grant founded the Resistance and raised a rebellion against the Crimson Dominion, Kragg again became needed by the Supreme Hierarch. He wanted Kragg to help Chancellor Doomerville bring order to the Western Sector. Chancellor Doomerville had Marshal at his disposal during the treatment after the "Hellish Hounds" incident.
Kragg believed that he had no equal in the ranks of the Imperials and he would destroy the Resistance in a short time, and he would do it in his own way - without rituals and obsessed cultists. That's whu he gave order to Kurt Heigen to gather soldiers that were loyal to him personally. But the search were taking a long time and the Resistance was surprisingly successful. Marshal realized that the time had come to intervene, and he started a battle with Captain Walker, who managed to unravel the Kragg's plan and eventually outwit him. The participants in those events recall that the captain personally led the breakthrough of his fighters through the ranks of the enemy, cut off the Marshal's troops from the main forces of the Crimson Dominion, and then drove him into a trap and killed him.

Reward: There's nothing worse than besieging a fortress. All soldiers know this universal truth. But "Phantom" special forces never consider this as a priority. They prefer to find vulnerability in the defense of the enemy, strike a blow and disappear in the endless corridors of Reinstein.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6475:description
Reward: Shortly after Doomerville stopped supervising the Reinstein sewerage, it became a hangout for local deserters, outcast and other misfits who had established their own orders. Getting rid of them will help us to retreat safely and be useful for the Chancellor.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6476:description
Reward: Misfits of Roseinstein have been planning to have their revenge on the odious Chancellor for years. And they all moved together towards realizing their intention, breaking their pickaxes and  gasping for air. Doomerville owed them the comforts of peaceful life and they are going to take away the most precious thing - the legendary Reinstein storage.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6477:description
Reward: Sabotage at the substation was quite successful. Power surge disabled energy barriers and defensive system of the fortress. Reistein is still the the most protected object of the Crimson Dominion, but it'll take a lot of time to repair it. And while the engineers will be working on it, the Storage will be taken out of the fortress and set off to Osterberg. Support troops will convoy it.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6478:description
Reward: Misfits were cornered, devoid of the reason for living, persecuted by Chancellor's troops and getting killed by "phantoms". They gathered strength for the las batlle for the pitiful shred of fortress sewerage which they call their home. Their fate is sad, but war means war and the best we can do for them is to put an end to the suffering.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6479:description
Reward: New ruler caused noticeable changes in the Rosenstein fortress. Once empty corridors are now filled with countless patrols in radiant scarlet armor. The garrison previously consisted of military police was replaced by the elite of the army. This decision of the Chancellor has weakened military establishment of the Crimson Dominion, but his disagreement with the Hierarch were stronger than reason.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6480:description
Reward: Chancellor Doomerville perceived lost of Marshal Kragg as a personal insult. It also made his paranoia worse and added lots of new phobias. "Wolves" were withdrawn from their current tasks and divided between patrols and fortress blocks. The lower levels, our current target, is closely guarded by the fighters of the general Singer, who is famous for bloody punitive operations in the eastern sector.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6481:description
Reward: Singer is a cautious person, but he's too self-confident. He'll definitely will intend to personally assess the scale of damage inflicted on the lower levels of the fortress. This will kill him. While most of his soldiers will be preparing to quell the unrest and the General himself will be prancing near the west wall wearing his patent leather boots, subdivision "Phantom" will stab him with\ndagger.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6482:description
Reward: Singer is dead, his dead body dangles in a loop on the fortress wall, so that everybody could understand the seriousness of our intentions. We would never do something like that in the old days, but the war has changed us. Adler, Hagen, Keller, Doomerville. Our fighters repeat these names like a mantra. Those bastards will be killed next, because we are the best troop of the Emperor, we are the "Phantom".

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6483:description
Reward: After Singer's deatр the lower levels of Reinstein are within our full possession. From now on a random patrol won't be a predator, but a victim in our deadly labyrinth of ambushes and traps. It would be worth to also inspect General's office for strategic information, because somebody from his "brilliant" subordinates can obliterate it.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6484:description
Reward: "You were born as Wolves, but you hide in the fortress loke rats. I am ashamed of you, as my mentor would be ashamed. I will personally track down his killer and make him suffer. And then I'll come back for you. You can entranch, you can run away, but your time will come and there would be no mercy." - Kurt Hagen

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6485:description
Reward: The found letter helped to correct the strategy and delayed the death sentence to one of the scoundrels in our list. According to Hagen, the enemy has circled the wagons and has no intention to leave it. "Magical flute" would come in handy for hunting "rats", but as long as we don't have it, we'll try to to forge Doomerville's order to General Adler by collecting his lieutenant's encryptions.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6486:description
Reward: Heinrich Adler is the Reinstein fortress prison warden. He is responsible for maintaining order, internal investigations and, of course, inhuman torture. On of his favorite hames is to feed mad lycanthropes with fortress prisoners. Adler's lieutenants live in constant fear, it's impossible to take them alive, but it's not a problem...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6487:description
Reward: Having forged the order about redeployment, we managed to lure the "rat" out of its hole. It's time to strike a decisive blow. We have to be ready that this attempt won't be easy. Adler has spent years watching the prisoners, he is always alert and never leaves prison without proper escort.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:6488:description

Reynald Ockfeller was born during times of Old Monarchy in a noble family. His father didn't skimp on education for his son, and therefore Reynald had the best teachers and all the necessary means for studying. Since Reynald was the only child in the family, he understood that he would inherit the whole fortune over time, which means that he had to learn how to handle money for not to lose everything earned by ancestors.
Ockfeller got his finance degree and became a royal treasurer. The monarch had little interests in public affairs, preferring to spend time with pleasure. Reynald could administer the treasury as he thought was best. He could control the tax policy of the country just by himself: invest in the interesting projects, determine the amount of salaries, fines, bonuses... But this didn't last long - the Old Reich came to power as a result of coups d'etat.
When disturbances erupted in the country, Ockfeller fabricated documents and got hold of some finances from treasury. The Chancellor wanted to arrange a demonstration trial and execute everybody from Monarch inner circle who didn't manage to escape, but Reynald was able to pay off and therefore all charges against him were dropped. Since then, the road to public service has been closed to him. Then Ockfeller decided to go into banking.
A few years later, there was another coup d'etat in the Crimson Dominion, the Supreme Hierarch of the Dark Gods with thier puppet - Chancellor Doomerville, came to power. Then the war against the Iron Empire started. After it was over, Anna-Maria's people (the daughter of the executed Monarch) came to Reynald. All this time, the princess hid underground and developed a plan of revenge. In order to weaken Doomerville and Supreme Hierarch, the princess wanted to help the imperial Resistance to get into Western sector, thereby diverting the attention of the ruling elite of the Crimson Dominion and weakening it with a new military conflict. With the royalists' money, Ockfeller had to supply the Resistance with equipment, while receiving a percentage for each successful delivery.
Following the tip from Anna-Maria's people, Reynald came upon John Fox, the quartermaster of the Crimson Dominion troops in the Western sector. Ockfeller made him an advantageous offer and they began to supply the troops of the new Iron Empire. When Commander Grant gave the order to start the uprising, Fox turned over to the Resistance and became their quartermaster, realizing that his previous command would certainly have raised questions about where did the imperials got the dominion weapons and equipment.
Following commander Grant, Anna-Maria herself came out of hiding, openly declaring her claims to the throne. Fearing that his ties with the royalists would be revealed, Ockfeller decided to move to the Western sector after John Fox. Having found refuge in the Osterberg fortress, Ockfeller began to trade with Vendor, waiting for Anna-Maria to come to power so that he could safely return back to his homeland.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:8540:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:8541:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9091:description
Reward: Captain! We don't know each other personally, but you have saved my and my people's lives several times already! I owe you Walker, like all of them. My name is John Le Cross - I'm the senior investigator for the Phantom squad, we infiltrated Reinstein and killed Doomerville. A special place among our merits is the destruction of "Liquidation" special squad - if it weren't for it, we wouldn't lost anybody during "Invasion" operation.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9092:description
Reward: But I am not writing to brag. Something happened that you should know about. In Reinstein, we stumbled upon a solitary prison cell, which was at the lowest level of Doomerville Palace. It was guarded, you won't believe it, even better than the chancellor himself with his gold tank. I expected to meet the Duke Blackburn or Anna-Maria inside the cell, but not chained up, dressed in tatters and barely alive, the former imperial intelligence agent - Mergen Dordge.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9093:description
Reward: I understood that if Doomerville kept him locked up under such protection, then he was obviously very valuable to the Crimson Dominion. Therefore, I decided to arrange an interrogation for Mergen, which lasted for several days. I could only learn from the captive that he was put in a cell by none other than Clemont VII, who ruled our country more than 100 years ago. Ha, how so! The local doctor immediately diagnosed - from numerous tortures and a long stay in solitary confinement, Mergen lost his mind, so he should be transferred to a local hospital. I agreed to the transferring, but something haunted me. And then I decided to look for information about the prisoner in the Doomerville papers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9094:description
Reward: I had to turn the chancellor's office upside down to find the information I needed. And what I learned, frankly, struck me. You should know, Captain, that Reinstein was imperial in the past, and only after the war ended, Doomerville make it his new home and capital of the Western sector. So, when he moved to this fortress, Mergen Dordge was already imprisoned in a cell! I found a mention of the dozens of interrogations that Doomerville initiated, but he ordered to destroy all their results and protocols! I wouldn't be surprised if he burned them personally in his fireplace!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9095:description
Reward: The only place where you could find out more about the mysterious captive was the Imperial Citadel. But how can we get there if it's closed? And you won't believe it — a couple days after the search in the chancellor's office, we picked up a radio message saying that the doors of the Citadel were reopened. I thought it was incredible luck and, went to the South-East with some fellow fighters. But while we were en route, a terrible thing happened - Mergen killed the guards assigned to him and all the medical staff of the hospital. Paving his way out of the corpses, he left Reinstein. I felt guilty, as if I had released the beast. But it was impossible to go in search of him - the Citadel was about to give us some answers, we were approaching it when we received a message about Dordge escape.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9096:description
Reward: Within the walls of the Citadel, we really found information about Mergen Dordge. Oh Gods, he was telling the truth, captain! 112 years ago, Clemont VII sent several reconnaissance units beyond Westphalian Wall. Only one Dordge came back. According to the recollections of eyewitnesses, he changed - someone ascribes to him an unhealthy red gleam in his eyes, and someone says that his blood has turned from red to green. By order of Clemont VII, Mergen was accused of treason. Dordge was imprisoned in solitary confinement at the lowest level of the Reinstein fortress. Why is he still alive? The answer lies in the personality of the Grand Master of the Order of the Imper. Not the current one, of course, although, as for me, they are all the same.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9097:description
Reward: There is a reason the Dark Age called Dark, Captain. Molten Flow - The Grand Master of Imper and a close friend of Clemont VII had to maintain order in the country and fight any manifestation of occultism, but he himself went over to the side of darkness. The emperor wanted to try Mergen, but Flow convinced his friend that Dordge would be a valuable captive and an ideal subject for learning Dark Magic. Clemont VII agreed with this and ordered the creation of special conditions for keeping Dordge, which would suppress the occult powers of the former intelligence officer. Molten planned to release the captive soon, but was caught red-handed and put on trial. Almost immediately after that, Clemont himself died, and his successor was too busy to worry about Dordge. The creation of a new joint facility under code number 12 has captured the attention of the new Emperor.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9098:description
Reward: So what did I have at that moment? Based on official chronicles, a hundred years ago, a former imperial scout made a deal with the Dark Gods and received some power from them. Only the fact that he did not have time to learn how to manage it allowed Clemont VII to put him in a cell. As a result of which all these years Dordge power was suppressed. After his release from prison, the Dark Gift began to reappear. I understood that in order to find Mergen, we had to enlist the help of those who had been fighting against Darkness for centuries. And so I went to the Order of "Crimson Sunset", to find the Missalea - my old friend, who became the Canoness.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9099:description
Reward: Missalea brought me to the archivist of Crimson Sunset. This gray-haired old man could barely stood on his feet, but his mind was clear and sharp. The nature of the Dark Gift of Mergen was known to him. According to him, such a quick restoration of Dordge contributed to reducing the gap between the worlds. The cult of the Four Eclipses could not call their masters into our world, the ritual was interrupted, but the veil was greatly exhausted and tears began to occur in different parts of the continent through which spirits and dark energy penetrated. The case of Commander Grant is a prime example! And Mergen, most likely, sensing this, set off to look for the nearest gap. We entered into a mutually beneficial agreement with the archivist - the Order's fighters will help me catch Dordge, and we, in return, will need to help them deal with the cultists who were seen at Westphalian Wall again - this is where the line of worlds was the thinest.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9100:description
Reward: You know, captain, history likes to repeat itself. We went to the Westphalian Wall, exactly the same as Mergen Dordge once went. As you know, only he returned back. Do you know where I'm going with this? We found Mergen, but didn't realize that it was him immediately. His face was disfigured. His weapon was saturated with the energy of darkness and enveloped his hands, wounding him and putting tentacles under his skin, remotely resembling vines. He lost his human appearance, but in return acquired tremendous power. I don't know what he intends to do with it, and frankly, I don't need to know. The archivist handed over artifacts that were supposed to help us cope with Mergen. Maybe you can find them a use. With this letter, I transfer my authority to you, Captain. These nightmares, they haunt me. Images of "Phantoms" obscure my eyes. I have already ceased to distinguish reality from the illusions of an inflamed mind. Goodbye Captain. I'm about to meet my friends at the eternal peace.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9551:description
Reward: Six months ago, Captain Walker established a defence treaty of mutual assistance with the northern tribes against Crimson Dominion and raiders. In a short period of time, joint efforts in the region brought order backed up until recently by northerners. Over the past month, the Resistance lost two convoys with ionite. Commander Grant believes it's time to meet with the alies and find out who is behind these attacks ...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9552:description
Reward: Right behind Eden Bay, where permafrost reins, Resistance troops were about to meet with the local tribes. To check the path for safety, Captain Walker sent several groups of rangers for reconnaissance. A few hours later, we received a one-word message from them: "bots", and communication line went dead. But they were lucky to activate an alarm with a rescue beacon indicating their location.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9553:description
Reward: Figuring that "bots" means "robots", the captain decided to advance at an accelerated pace to the beacon signal. In conditions of extremely low temperature, beacon spent its charge much faster than usual and therefore it was necessary to get there before the power will be down. But as soon as the Imperials advanced in the indicated direction, robots appeared on the horizon.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9554:description
Reward: Scouts were right! These are not ordinary robots - these are bots! A year ago, on the northeastern outskirts of the Western sector, the Resistance forces destroyed Klausbot - a robot created by a crazy scientist who almost single-handedly killed the 2nd shock army. Those mechanisms that just showed up at Eden Bay, although much weaker, are clearly created on the basis of Klausbot. And if so, then the scientist kept his promise and returned, creating himself a new army.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9555:description
Reward: The beacon signal went down just at the moment when the Resistance troops reached the battlefield between the bots and the rangers. As soon as the Resistance fighters approached the bodies of their fellow soldiers, bots began to rise from all sides from under the snow. It seems that they clearly knew about the rescue beacon - or maybe... they turned it on themselves

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9556:description
Reward: Breaking out of the ambush, the Imperials rushed further north - they needed to cross the Eden Bay as soon as possible and meet with the local tribes. A few kilometers away from the Dun Heim Rocks soldiers were expecting to meet the observation posts of the Uruzgal clan - they were the first ones to see Walker when he arrived to sign the peace treaty six months ago. But in order to get there, Imperials need to defeat the bots first and these bots didn't intend to let them cross to the other side of the bay.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9557:description
Reward: The observation posts of the Uruzgal clan are destroyed, and the snow skirmisher who served here are killed! Bots are following Imperials closely behind. The only way out in this situation is to take up the defense and repulse the mechanisms, and then go further into the Dun Heim Rocks in search of local tribes.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9558:description
Reward: The last bot is destroyed, but there is no time to take a breath and relax. Very soon, new mechanisms will appear. After leaving what remained of the observation posts of the Uruzgal clan, the Imperials headed inland to the Dun Heim Rocks. The last time Walker was here, he followed the guide - but now the captain was on his own. From a long transition and exhausting battles, he got confused and decided to halt, which led to another attack by bots, which, unlike people, did not know fatigue.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9559:description
Reward: When the battle was in full swing, members of the local tribes of Parturaz and Tureyvaz arrived for help just in time, guided here by the sounds of the battle. Representatives of the clans said that bots began their regular attacks on local tribes a month ago, killed those who resisted and captured those who weren't armed or couldn't fight. Scouts from the tribes were managed to find out what they came from the Irsguard mines direction. When asked whether the convoys with ionite were also intercepted by bots, the representatives didn't know anything.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9560:description
Reward: While negotiations were ongoing, the bots attacked again. Surrounded by northerners and imperials, mechanisms weren't afraid to come down from the mountains and show thier their "faces".

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9561:description
Reward: When the battle was over, Captain Walker ordered a halt. And then, after teaming up with the warriors of the Parturaz and Tureyvaz clans, the imperial set off towards the Irsguard mines. Apparently, Klaus gave his toys an order - to kill every last one of the people. How else one can explain the fact that more and more bots attacked with every step of their way?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9562:description
Reward: The Dun Heim Rocks are left behind. The combined forces of the northerners and the Resistance reached the road from the Protectorate Valley to Zone X-69. It seems that this is the road that Magnus uses to deliver convoys with ionite to Osterberg. Walker's attention was drawn to the fact that there were completely fresh car tracks along another road in the direction of Irsguard mines. A moment later, new bots appeared from there.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9563:description
Reward: Having dealt with the bots, the combined forces under the command of Walker soon reached the industrial factory. Near the entrance they saw the New Order truck and captive members of local tribes that where unloading it, Walker noticed that they were unloading boxes with ionite and spare parts. Captives were guarded by other northerners - from the Yeralguz clan. The territory of the factory was patrolled by bots. Without waiting for them to be noticed, Walker ordered to attack.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9564:description
Reward: People from Yeralguz clan are defending alongside the bots! What does it mean - the whole clan is cooperating with Klaus or only some of its representatives?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9565:description
Reward: The factory is seized, and the prisoners are released! Those who are able to hold weapons in their hands have joined the combined army and are eager for revenge! According to former prisoners, this workshop is only part of the large Ardheim factory complex No. 34. Well, then we'll take control of it all!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:9566:description
Reward: The rest of the captives are kept not far from the assembly workshops No. 2 and No. 3, which are guarded by "Stormtrooper" type bots - these are elite machines with high mobility and incredible combat power. Defeating them will not be easy - but we need to do this and free the northerners!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10449:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10450:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10453:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10454:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10455:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10456:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10457:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10458:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10459:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10460:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10461:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10462:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: flash:1582123910021
Reward: He was one of the first to learn about the disappearance of people in the mines. Without support, cover and communication with the Resistance Command, he was able to get to the farthest corner of the mine. Of course, the Resistance Command were not aware of such an initiative, but they immediately realized who exactly was that creature that escaped from the mine.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: flash:1582124841105
Reward: Elsa was appointed a combat escort officer to the expedition. Her vast combat experience was a decisive factor for the command in choosing a person for this job. freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: flash:1582124874624
Reward: Sending a robot to reconnaissance, which is not vulnerable to diseases, at first seemed an excellent solution to command. Imagine their surprise when the machine stopped responding to direct orders, and then communication line went dead. After some time, this appeared from the mine...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10076:description
Reward: According to intelligence reports, there are anomalous activities in all mining towns that mentally affect living organisms. Symptoms of infection: headaches, apathy, sleepiness, visual hallucinations, disorientation. The patient's condition worsens especially quickly in confined spaces and rooms, but all symptoms listed above thin out and the vivacity of the spirit returns, once the infected soldier go outside. Based on reports from soldiers who managed to survive an intelligence operation, they came up with two ways to reduce the risk of infecting soldiers and to suppress the mental impact on their brain from a source in the depths of the mine.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10088:description
Reward: At this level of the mine there was a lot of explosions. Soldiers practically deprived us of samples for research. The underground "pockets", from which crowds of infected people climb, are filled with a kind of incubators. We believe that infected are being mutilated in them. The results of these mutations we can see with our own eyes in battle. That is, when a person gets under mental control, he goes to a mine and takes a place in a similar incubator, so that later he could become a crystal-covered mindless monster.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10089:description
Reward: Incubators are some organic formations that inject minerals and other chemical compounds into the human body, which causes the formation of crystalline growths first on the human skeleton and then on the skin. Minerals are the purest ionite, but because of tectonic features of this area of the continent and because of the still unknown factor affecting changes in the structure of the ionite - this mineral is perfectly suited for interaction with the human body. It's amazing how many secrets the ionite still holds! People use it everywhere in everyday live: from compact flashlight batteries to giant tesla coils that power the gun systems of walking machines.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10090:description
Reward: A person stays in an incubator in the form of anabiosis while his body is undergoing changes. I wonder if he stays conscious at this time, does he feel the world around him as before, or at the very least does he dream? We have made an official request to the Commander to allow us to study a living specimen inside the incubator. We believe we can simulate a natural state of rest for the incubator without provoking it to bring its captive down on us. If the simulation is successful, we will be able to investigate the brain impulses of an infected person and examine in detail the processes that are taking place in his or her body at that moment. We're still waiting for an answer.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10077:description
Reward: The Commander reluctantly agreed to spare the manpower for experiment with incubator. I understand his fears and the increased security measures that limit us in many ways in our methods, but we must make the most of this experience to better understand the nature of the entity we have encountered. During our preparation for the experiment, we learned that the human brain is needed as a conductor between our equipment and the incubator. The brain serves as a sort of authorization tool, while an incubator is a terminal that can only interact with the environment through the human brain. We developed some protective measures in case something happens to the volunteer and the experiment goes wrong. I hope it goes smoothly, because Steiner volunteered. He is the only one among the members of our scientific team who has natural resistance to mental influence.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10082:description
Reward: By exploring the mine, we have better understanding of the nature of local situation, but the overall picture of the observed phenomenon is still a mystery for us. Among the protective devices in this mine there are so-called psionic propulsors - smooth, almost perfect crystals attached to a pedestal by chains. They emit powerful waves of psionic energy, turning soldiers into panicking madmen. Originally, when we first saw these structures, we assumed that they were ritual or symbolic. Our group even walked past one of them without any effect. These psionic beacons demonstrated their true nature only in the thick of the battle: making a long ringing sound, the beacon flashed a blue light - and everybody who were in the range of the wave began to squirm in pain, throwing their weapons, grabbing their heads in agonies, rushing from side to side, becoming easy prey for the infected. Some, unable to contain the pain, attacked the sharp crystals sticking out of the walls with their whole bodies. It's a terrible sight, especially when you realize that these soldiers are your brothers in arms, who unable to resist in this state.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10083:description
Reward: As soon as we broke away from the waves of the infected, we retreated. For regrouping. That's what the Commander said, at least... I suggested we reconfigure our defenses and try to approach the beacon for radiation measurements. My proposal was rejected and Commander ordered us to destroy the beacon so we could move on. He also said that we could check what was left of the beacon later. There's an oppressive feeling next to this structure and it's visibly affecting the mood of everyone in the group. This place is putting pressure on us, but the situation would be much worse if we didn't have the protection created by Resistance scientists and produced in large quantities in such a short time. The defense is not perfect and needs calibration, but it's better than nothing.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10084:description
Reward: A destroyed beacon is not as valuable as I thought it would be at first. It's a kind of nerve cluster, part of a common network. I'm guessing we'll meet more than one beacon like this. Our team will try to calibrate the devices to reduce the negative impact on soldiers' minds. I'll ask the Commander to get us some of the equipment from the camp on the surface with the next back up team. I must also mention, the soldiers who managed to escape in a panic attack, survived and didn't go crazy, told me about the visions that appeared in their heads when they were exposed to the beacon. In their visions was the image of a man in a blue halo of light with his eyes wide open. The longer they looked into his eyes, the louder they heard his voice. He spoke an unfamiliar language, filling all the thoughts, suppressing the will to resist. After talking to them, the Commander sent them to the surface, because they been through more than all of us.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10085:description
Reward: A couple of hours of sleep is enough for a man with a strong will to lose control over his body and become a puppet in the hands of local forces. Before we arrived, the command conducted a major reconnaissance operation led by Lieutenant Marder. In his report on the operation, he said that the infected could leave the mine to neutralize the threat or catch up with those who also somehow escaped. Corporal Benson, one of the group leaders, is the only one who has been infected and survived. Thanks to his phenomenon, we were able to modify the soldiers' gas mask breathing filters to better protect them from dust, as well as create a psionic protection device to protect the fighter's brain from mental exposure. More precisely, it reduces the impact, we could not provide full protection in the field.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10086:description
Reward: We stumbled upon a new artifact, a dark obelisk covered in unknown letters. It has the same crystalline structure as the other monuments in the mine. Unfortunately, our experience with the psionic beacons didn't help us with interacting with the obelisk. It's able to take our soldiers under temporary control from a distance, turning them against his comrades. We have seen them resist the obelisk's impact by reluctantly turning their weapons against their fellow soldiers. This time there were more victims... as infected psionics wasn't enough. Those who didn't have time to react were killed, and people who knew what was happening at once, were suppressed by the fact that their brothers-in-arms were killed. The commander gave an inspirational speech and many were cheered up. We set up a camp for now, we all need a break from what happened. The obelisk was destroyed as soon as everyone who tried to kill our soldiers died, and we will be able to examine it only after rest.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10087:description
Reward: We took samples of the obelisk to conduct a detailed study of its structure, but we were unable to decipher the writing on its surface. It's the task of the linguists, but we don't have any of them anymore. Hopefully, there will be enough photos of the inscriptions for professors of linguistics if we get out of here. From what we have learned by examining the rubble of the obelisk, it is that they serve as a repository of information in addition to known combat abilities. Their structure encrypts the information from the infected victims and any external interactions. We can only decipher it in a field lab on the surface, but we need this knowledge to better understand the nature of what's going on here. Personally, I hope the damaged obelisk is as valuable as functioning.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10746:description
Reward: Commander, it is difficult for me to give any conclusion without preliminary analysis, but it is not like anything we have encountered before. At first I thought about the influence of occult forces, but our analysers are silent. I will send a more detailed report tomorrow when the samples we have collected will pass a series of tests...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10747:description
Reward: We came across the first expedition, most likely. I can't confirm. The way they look makes identification difficult. Tests have proven the biological nature of all metamorphosis affecting the environment and living organisms.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10748:description
Reward: Commander, there's been another attack on our camp! We were able to contain and isolate one of the attackers. My team is now running all possible tests and monitors his reaction to the drugs we know. I can preliminarily say it's all the virus's fault. It's completely different from anything that science has ever known before. It's not typical, but it's definitely a virus.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10749:description
Reward: After my first research, I found some explanation for what's going on. When the body is affected, the virus turns off the pain receptors first. It explains how people continue to function peacefully considering all this agonizing damage to the whole body. It's the only way we can get new samples.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10750:description
Reward: Urgent news! Commander, we need reinforcements! The test subject has passed away. Nobody saw that comming. During the test, he just stopped showing signs of life. And when his body was being prepared for further autopsy, he threw himself at a team of doctors. But he was dead! That was confirmed by all the tests! He attacked my people and even managed to kill a few before he was riddled with bullets so much that his muscles could no longer function.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10751:description
Reward: We've been on the defensive for more than a day. I've noticed that most of the infected come from one side. I'd risk assuming that's where the source of the infection is. To top it all off, the medics who worked with the test subject showed the first symptoms of the disease. Looks like the virus can spread almost any way.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10752:description
Reward: Commander! Our group has stumbled upon an abandoned loot camp. Apparently, all residents were infected and left it. They may have become one of those we've already destroyed, or maybe we haven't met them yet. The important thing is that now I know where the disease came from... Damn it! We've been attacked again. Another wave...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10753:description
Reward: Continuing my last report... Ardheim's research bunker, do you remember we found documents there that have non-standard markings? Now I understand that they were working on biological enhancements, but not ordinary, like mutagen. I suspect the virus is their next project. Anyway, even if spreading of this virus can't be stop, we need that bunker. There's got to be some research to help make the antidote.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10754:description
Reward: We are fighting our way down deep into the Wasteland. Half my medical staff can't move anymore - the disease has completely affected them. The rest of the group is also starting to show symptoms of infection. Our resources are running out, and opponents didn't even come close to run out. The situation is significantly aggravated by the fact that after the death of a host, the virus turns him into a much more dangerous monster than a living infected.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10755:description
Reward: We were caught up by the backup you sent us. Thank you. Now we have a chance. The unfortunate thing is, I'm starting to feel the symptoms of the disease, too. We need to speed things up. If we don't find the antidote now, then it's too late. This infection is spreading lightning fast...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10756:description
Reward: Commander! We have reached the bunker. Our team split up to cover the research team that came inside. I can't go in there - the disease is progressing, I can't move fully anymore. I'll stay outside.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10757:description
Reward: Apparently, the infection really came from here - I've never seen so many of these creatures! Besides, the infection made them stronger and tougher. It's harder and harder to contain their attacks. Hopefully the group that came down inside will have time to get back before they kill us all.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10758:description
Reward: Our team came back from the bunker! They brought all the documents and research protocols they could find. I need time to look through all this. Maybe I can find some answers in them.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10759:description
Reward: My subordinates, who suddenly got better, demanded to give them weapons. I didn't even think they could do it... when they broke out of camp, they took some of the attackers with them. They gave us some time by paying for it with their lives.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10760:description
Reward: Yes! I... we created the antidote! Now all we have to do is survive. If we can't get it to Command Center, all those victims were for nothing. We will survive for any cost. But if not, Commander, you have to send troops to these coordinates and take my research and the antidote.

Reward: After the victory of the Empire, the best gladiators have joined the ranks of our soldiers. More than a worthy fate for fighters who change their lives to the rapturous cry of the crowd.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10957:description
Reward: Sometimes they are perplexed by the orders to intercept enemy convoys they used to accompany. But after the arena closes, they don't have much choice.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10959:description
Reward: The former Coliseum guards now cover our soldiers in battle. They break into battle like wild beasts, ignoring the orders of their commanders. Looks like they've yet to learn what structure and military discipline are.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10960:description
Reward: These creatures were once humans too, they were one of the last ones to be caught in the crystal net. With a considerable amount of knowledge in the human anatomy and knowing the enemy it will have to face, the cold mind of the crystal has changed them so much that the most terrible nightmares pale in comparison with them. Their huge stature, monstrous physical strength and crystal skin make them exceptionally dangerous opponents.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10961:description
Reward: They don't work well on the team, and they don't always understand orders. This makes it difficult to integrate them into the imperial troops. But it's always nice to look at their battles.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10962:description
Reward: We're still wondering how these madmen can create such machines. Betting on the Iron Guards during the arena battles is the most win-win situation. When there are no fights, they are the most reliable guards.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10963:description
Reward: Many were surprised by the strength and cruelty of Flame's Hellhounds. The strongest fighters who want to join their ranks, Flame equips with flamethrowers and sends to the arena - to prove that they are worth something.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10964:description
Reward: Very little is known about these warriors. They came from the far north and converted their axes into rifles to be on par with the local soldiers. But anyone who dares to look into their eyes will see only horror and death there.

Reward: The miners were the first and not the most successful slaves of the psionic Call. Without the necessary knowledge, Crystal only changed their bodies minimally for fear of damaging a fragile human body.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10967:description
Reward: The elite of the "ionite" army. At first glance, it may seem that they don't pose any threat, but in fact, a frail body and a huge head hide a monstrous psionic power. In addition to delivering powerful strikes of psionic energy, they act as brain centers, leading the rest of the infected.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10968:description
Reward: Silent soldiers patrol the long corridors of the underground city. Every day they check the condition of the stasis capsules, where hundreds of mechanical creatures are waiting in the wings.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10969:description
Reward: Equipped with deadly scythes, these mechanical creatures are ready to destroy anyone who dares to invade the underground city. The glint of a green eyepiece is the last thing their victim sees.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10970:description
Reward: The stone floor shudders from his footsteps, the mechanical warrior seeks out the victim and prepares to riddle it with machine-gun bursts. You better run while you still have the opportunity.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10971:description
Reward: Do not underestimate its danger during battle. While the vanguard distracts attention, the hunter seeks out weak opponents, and blows their heads off with a rapid-fire gauss rifle.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10972:description
Reward: The surface of the helmets was richly decorated with images and engravings. Part of the surface may have been covered in gold or silver or tin plated to imitate it. The weight of a gladiator helmet is about twice that of a soldier's helmet. However, the soldiers had to wear their helmet all day long and the gladiator only put it on before the fight, which lasted 10-15 minutes.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10973:description
Reward: In the old days, Thracian gladiators were armed with a very short sword with a slightly curved blade called a sica, intended to maim an opponent's unarmoured back. With the growth of technology, tradition changed slightly. Now the curved blade is mounted on a special rifle, but warriors still prefer close combat.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10974:description
Reward: Respirator with special antibacterial filters. Unfortunately, it does not purify the air. Therefore, its use is not widespread.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10975:description
Reward: As a rule, gladiators performed on the arena with a naked torso, which gave them the opportunity to show the audience their chest and shoulders muscles. But protection is also important, that's why some fighters wear a small breastplate on their chest to protect the heart area.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10976:description
Reward: Initially the gladiator units were divided into two parts, one of which tried to swaddle the enemies with nets and the other stab them with cold weapons. This gladiators weapon might have quite unusual story, on the one hand, but on the other, that is hella useful weapon in practice. And that's not even the end of the story.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10977:description
Reward: The air filtration unit is designed specifically for chemical protection suit. Its filters cool the air supplied to the suit, thus enabling a person to use the suit longer. Expensive materials and built-in medical support mechanisms do not allow mass production of this device, but at the moment "Individual air filtration unit" is the best that the army can provide for a soldier.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10978:description
Reward: Reinforced with kevlar fabric and mail chain, this airtight suit provides an excellent level of protection, but it won't last long. Because of the airtight and thick layer of armor, the soldier overheats too quickly and can die from cardiac arrest.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10979:description
Reward: The best minds in the engineering department created this atomiser specifically to fight the artificial virus that escaped from Ardheim. Two parallel hydraulic systems allow the soldier to instantly switch between modes: a flamethrower to destroy the infected, or a sprayer to clear the area of the deadly virus.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10980:description
Reward: Equipped with advanced gauss technology, the helmet allows to fix the thermal radiation of enemies, which significantly increases the aiming range and effectiveness of snipers.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10981:description
Reward: The upgraded Ultratech armor allows stormtroopers to fight their way through the barrage of fire and launch lightning attacks on the enemy base.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10982:description
Reward: It was extremely difficult for an ordinary person to hold two machine guns, so the engineers developed a full-fledged combat robot. The T-39 is a real death machine that sweeps away everything in its path.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:10983:description
Reward: During the cleaning of the Labyrinth, we collected the remaining parts from the destroyed robots. Our engineers have been able to turn this pile of scrap metal into a stunning outfit called the Ultratech.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11538:description
Reward: We've dealt with cult but swarms of possesed are still arriving. Besides, Commander Grant hasn't responded to our requests. He hasn't returned to Fort's location since his mission and there are no signs of his actions or movement. That doesn't sound like him. And most strange of this all is that soldiers brought me a name tag from the body of one of the possesed. Commander, the name tag is ours. Every possesed has such tag. We are fighting our own men. Let's cature one alive, immediatley.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11539:description
Reward: We haven't got any useful information from the possessed prisoner. He was just laughing madly and shouting that his master would destroy us and that we will be betrayed by an ally, so they will watch it. We recognized these possessed, they are from the troops that went on a mission with Commander Grant. I don't want to bury him yet, but we'll prepare for the worst.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11540:description
Reward: Commander, recent allies have arrived. Order of the Crimson Sunset wants to talk to you. They look like they were fighting a heavy battle. Apparently, we are not the only target of the possessed. Anyway, no one knows these occult things better than them. Maybe they can explain what's happening. We have hurry up, the enemy is on their tail.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11541:description
Reward: Commander, it is clear that one of the rituals we interrupted has borne fruit. Some creatures were able to break into our world and, taking advantage of the fact that the border between the worlds became thinner, possessed Commander Grant. Now we can't say for sure whether he can be saved or not. To do that, we need access to the Order's library. We need to create a free pass to our allies - they will look for information and by our arrival they will be able to provide answers to all questions that interest us.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11542:description
Reward: Commander, we have gathered our forces and it's time to go to the fortress of the Order of the Crimson Sunset. There we'll receive information about whether it's possible to save Grant or we have lost our ally forever. Let's get rid of the those remnants of the possessed and go!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11543:description
Reward: Grant may have become possessed, but he still has his skills and intelligence! I hear volleys of guns, the possessed are attacking the fortress. This is the only place where we can get the information on how to defeat them. We have to speed up, Commander. We can't lose so many comrades at one time.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11544:description
Reward: We were right! The Order took all the cultists artifacts from the ritual site. According to their information, this scepter can suppress the will of a demon who has possessed a person, and even subordinate him. The only problem is that the carrier has to be as weak as possible, so that the demon's power would be used to support vital functions. We have to practically kill Grant to use the scepter.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11545:description
Reward: Commander, we have problems! The enemy sabotage team has penetrated the vault and attempted to steal the scepter. The warriors of the Order were able to repel the attack, but the enemy has taken part of the scepter! We need to catch up with them urgently before they get to their main forces.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11546:description
Reward: We were too carried away by the chase, Commander! While we were finishing off the remnants of the sabotage team, Grant has secretly led his troops and suddenly attacked us with all his power. He even lifted the siege from the fortress. Everything will be decided here, Commander. We must not only win, but also save the enemy's life.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11580:description
Reward: Right behind Eden Bay, where permafrost reins, Resistance troops were about to meet with the local tribes. To check the path for safety, Captain Walker sent several groups of rangers for reconnaissance. A few hours later, we received a one-word message from them: "bots", and communication line went dead. But they were lucky to activate an alarm with a rescue beacon indicating their location.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11581:description
Reward: Figuring that "bots" means "robots", the captain decided to advance at an accelerated pace to the beacon signal. In conditions of extremely low temperature, beacon spent its charge much faster than usual and therefore it was necessary to get there before the power will be down. But as soon as the Imperials advanced in the indicated direction, robots appeared on the horizon.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11583:description
Reward: We failed to interrogate Lycassa. And the conflict between Captain Walker and Savage is escalating. Nevertheless, we must move on. From the smell, we're approaching the mutagen vault. It's being used to make stimulants and bioimplants. But who's behind all this has yet to know...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11584:description
Reward: Blitz the "Dust Rat" is probably the one who can best cope with the task of transforming ordinary people and animals in a fierce and living creatures for the arena. His Rats gang, are the psychos who have been mutated into ratchers, and with their help Blitz keeps all the mutagen stocks in the area under control. But his triumph has come to an end. Today, we're gonna end this madness.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11585:description
Reward: Blitz came back to life with a mutagen. And his "rats" got even fiercer. Although it's just fun for him, we have a hard fight ahead of us, but we have to win this bloody game... and survive.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11586:description
Reward: We finished him and moved on. But now we have an even more terrible picture: land and buildings destroyed by fire, and around them - charred human remains. According to Savage, there's a strange cult of fire. He knows enough about these places, even more than expected.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11587:description
Reward: We found out that behind these arsons and atrocities are the "Hellhounds", the Flame's gang. But where is he? He's probably lurking and waiting for the right moment. But we can't wait - a new wave of his arsonists are on their way.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11588:description
Reward: Savage has betrayed us. He turned out to be the very Organizer who arranged these games. And Lycassa, Blitz and Flame are just his accomplices. Turns out he just played a role with Lycassa and Blitz to trap us. And they did it. We can't contact Commander Grant from here. All we have to do is hope for our own strength. We must win, the Empire is counting on us!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: structures:18:likeBonus:text:4

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11593:description
Reward: The time of hiding, indulgence and picking up scraps from other gangs is over. Lycassa decided to prove once and for all how dangerous and deadly a woman can be in the wasteland if she wants to. She was immediately surrounded by like-minded people, whom she called "Desert Snakes".

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11594:description
Reward: Flame's vanity and madness have always been known to the wastelands, but now they have reached their peak. He considers himself a true god, and the Hellhounds are his followers. He burns the innocents, calling it his "sacrifice", and he does not stop until the whole world absorbs his flame.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11595:description
Reward: We thought Blitz madness was the limit. But gods, we were so wrong. This lunatic put a giant mutagen tank on himself and became practically unkillable! And he started pumping his followers with mutagens with the real rat genome! And now these creatures are killing anyone on his whim.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11495:poll_description
Reward: Host: God of Fire was slaughtered by the servant of the empire! Who'd have thought! Looks like we overestimated our Flame! So what do we do with him now? Would you dare to kill the self-proclaimed God? Or may this world continue to tolerate him?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11495:poll_text_A
Reward: Host: In spite of your shame, Flame, the audience is ready to forgive you! Because who else is going to give us a blood-fired show like you! Nevertheless, we recognize the extraordinary strength and resilience of our gladiator Walker! Perhaps the Organizer himself will come down to fight with him!\nSavage: Not so fast! You really are a strong opponent, Walker, just what I was looking for. But I want to see how you handle my fighters. Do you deserve to fight me?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11495:poll_text_B
Reward: Host: Walker cut Flame's life short! Now the "Hellhounds" are left without a leader! And we were sure that the enemy was out of his league! Well, we were wrong, Walker proved his strength and now deserves a fight with the Organizer himself!\nSavage: Not so fast! You really are a strong opponent, Walker, just what I was looking for. But I want to see how you handle my fighters. Do you deserve to fight me?

Reward: We're still wondering how these madmen can create such machines. Betting on the Iron Guards during the arena battles is the most win-win situation. When there are no fights, they are the most reliable guards.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11642:description
Reward: Many were surprised by the strength and cruelty of Flame's Hellhounds. The strongest fighters who want to join their ranks, Flame equips with flamethrowers and sends to the arena - to prove that they are worth something.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11643:description
Reward: Very little is known about these warriors. They came from the far north and converted their axes into rifles to be on par with the local soldiers. But anyone who dares to look into their eyes will see only horror and death there.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11651:description
Reward: The thieves decided the fate of the half-captain by wheel of fortune. He was thrown to the Berserks cave. He seems to have no chance... But he's still fighting for life. Even when his own mind is turned against him...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11652:description
Reward: Despite all the ordeals that fell to Captain Walker's fate, he survived. He was rescued by escaped slaves led by Cairo. But there's no way to sit back and lick his wounds. The games are about to start, and there's no better time to attack - we must take the Coliseum Gate. But we can't do it on our own, so we use "Genofrost" Armored truck. All we have to do is grab it...

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11653:title
Reward: At the edge of the abyss HM

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11653:description
Reward: The armored truck is broken, but we still managed to get to the arena. Release the slaves and escape now, alas, will be much harder. That's why Captain Walker decided to hold his opponents off on his own, giving Cairo a chance to escape. Will Walker be able to win? Or is this the captain's last heroic act?

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11654:description
Reward: The captain was by a thread from death, but to survive, he volunteered to participate in these crazy games. And by the rules of these lands, they couldn't refuse him. Heavy battles are ahead, and who knows if the captain will have the strength to reach the end. Everything is at stake now.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11655:title
Reward: Ripping off the snake skin HM

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11655:description
Reward: So, the first serious opponent is Lycassa. Savage managed to trick Walker into pretending to kill her. But now it's just Walker and her. There's nowhere to run and nowhere to hide. May the strongest one win!

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11656:description
Reward: Here comes Blitz... Turns out he didn't even die a second time! Trick or incredible regenerative powers? Who knows what this madman will do now? But the only thing that's clear for now is that we need to destroy the Rat, because there won't be other chance.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11657:description
Reward: The next opponent is Flame. He's probably even crazier than Blitz. Even without his hounds, Flame is incredibly dangerous. But he'll pay in full for all the innocents, all the ones burned in his name. And in the meantime, Walker has less and less strength left... But he can't give up. Not now. Not now.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11658:description
Reward: Looks like Savage is trying to weaken Walker as much as possible. Now the captain's waiting to fight with the personal guards, the mighty Vikings Harold and Halfdan. The battle will be unequal, and they have proven themselves to be mighty warriors before, and it will not be easy to deal with them. But that doesn't scare Walker anymore. It's all about getting to Savage. Whatever the cost.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11659:description
Reward: Success! Now Savage will pay for his betrayal in full. The final and the hardest fight. No one knows how it will end. Not just the captain's life is at stake, but the honor of the Iron Empire and the power in this region. Besides, it's the captain's personal business now, because he can't forgive betrayals.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11669:description
Reward: The Dark Gods have a very twisted understanding of what help and healing are. Their own followers wanted to create a place where their soldiers could heal wounds and injuries from battle, but it turned out quite differently.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11670:description

But instead it had an effect on the nearest defensive point: it absorbed all the living things around it, shaping it into a single piece of flesh, and seemed to come to life. Now the spirit of the most powerful sorcerer is forever enslaved within.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:11671:description
Reward: The powers of the Dark Gods are able to influence not only the living, but also the machines, endowing them with their own will. Dark energy began to influence the steel itself, changing it like bones, as a result of which those who did not have time to escape were consumed by the hunger of the revived machine gun.
