Reward:
The "Warrington" frigate belonged to the Iron Armada. The Crimson Dominion concluded a contract with it for the supply of weapons and military equipment. So that other factions would not know about it, the Armada and the Dominion decided to conduct operations under the guise of joint military exercises. According to legend, the Iron Armada allocated a frigate to it, and the Supreme Hierarch of its soldiers. In fact, containers and boxes of supplies were unloaded from Armada's ships on board the Warrington, and then the frigate headed south towards the Citadel.

For a long time, these maneuvers remained unnoticed until a small gang of looters led by Rusty Jaws raided one of the Crimson Dominion trans-shipment points where Warrington unloaded some of the containers and sailed onward. Successfully capturing the point and disrupting local workers and security, the raiders began to study the trophies, but played with new unfamiliar technologies. As a result, an explosion occurred in the newly-established marauder settlement, and fireworks attracted the attention of both the Dominion and one of the Resistance commanders. To repel the supplies and prevent them from falling into the hands of Grant's subordinates, the Warrington crew decided to seize the communications station, using the frigate as a striking force. After shelling the coast with the ship's guns, naval paratroopers landed on shore and began assaulting the trans-shipment point. The "Rusty Jaws" gang managed to break without any problems, although the marauder leader himself managed to escape.

After that, the frigate was anchored. Soldiers of the Crimson Dominion began to restore fortifications and expect reinforcements from neighboring sectors. At that time, the scouts sent by the commander of the local Resistance unit transmitted all available information about what had happened to their commander. The latter, in turn, realizing that he could not cope with the frigate alone, decided to merge with the other Resistance unit and seize the ship together with the communications station until the Crimson Dominion troops had established themselves on the coast to then investigate the contents of the cargoes marked with the Iron Armada coat of arms.

During the storm, most of the Warrington crew were killed in battle, and the rest, unwilling to see the frigate and cargo fall into the hands of the emperors, blew up and sank their ship.

Reward:
Genetics in pre-war times was treated with caution, even steroids were banned, as the Iron Empire based its development on the principles of mechanics and engineering, and all other branches of science were financed by the residual principle. Many innovative methods and means were banned because they were potentially dangerous to the lives and health of citizens.

After the uprising raised by Commander Grant, it became clear that everything that could be useful in the fight against the Crimson Dominion must be used to win. This decision untied the hands of imperial geneticists and allowed them to engage in experiments.

The study of the foundations of genetics and organic chemistry led to the discovery of the laws of heredity and recombination. Micropreparations and stimulants were created that could fully reveal the congenital potential of recruits, and even more - improve it several times.

New types of fuel were discovered, mustard gas and healing catalyst BF-13a were created to accelerate healing of wounds of fighters.

For a long time, lycanthropes and werewolves were considered only products of occult nature, but thanks to advances in genetics, Resistance scientists were able to turn several volunteers into controlled creatures of darkness without occult magic under experimental conditions and start using them for their own purposes. Similar results were achieved in the transformation of humans into berserks.

The "Expulsion" campaign was a new milestone in the history of genetics. At the seized Ardheim Factory № 23, Resistance scientists gained access to large reserves of pre-war mutagen developed under the Genesis program. A safe analog of this mutagen was produced in underground laboratories founded by order of Commander Grant, which marked the beginning of the program on "Cooperation of the Resistance and Wasteland inhabitants".

Finally, using captured materials and research from Genofrost, the company that was engaged in genetic research, the Resistance was able to reach a new level in the knowledge of the mutagen and the creation of an ideal soldier. A specially built complex of underground laboratories, the highest level of secrecy, the best scientists of the mind, several dozens of unsuccessful samples and killed guards - all this was necessary to create Mogran - an ideal soldier, a hundred of whom would have to end this war.

"Genetics is the leading branch of science. All others are secondary."
© Dr. Pierce

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12495:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12496:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12497:description
Reward: With each new discovery, new ritual, new experiment we come closer and closer to the use of this force for good. But all scientists dream of a future where they will never have to use something like that.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12498:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12499:description
Reward: Experiments with unknown forces can lead to dire consequences. Every day, our scientists undergo many psychological and physical examinations to prevent possible danger. Even in the face of promises of unimaginable power and opportunity, the faith of our soldiers is unshakable.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12500:description
Reward: Every day reveals more and more secrets for us, but there are also more and more questions. But it is naive to think that one day we will be able to curb this power. This is just another tool and nothing more.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12501:description
Reward: Our scientists theorize that there may be many other dark forces besides the ones we know. And there is a possibility that their own greed and enmity between these gods could be another tool in our favor. But these are just theories.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12502:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12503:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12504:description
Reward: Almost all experiments were complete success. Our soldier received unique abilities to control otherworldly forces. But strange reactions have been noticed with some occult subjects. It takes more time to study.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12505:description

The reason was that his connection with otherworldly forces acts in the complete opposite of what was expected - his body and mind completely denies and rejects the influence of Chaos. Our fighter has full immunity.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12506:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12507:description
Reward: Using our amazing results with Volunteer #217, we can create a variety of tools and equipment that he can use to enhance his abilities. Also, some witnesses report that various cursed objects near our soldier lose their strength and become nothing but ordinary.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12508:description
Reward: To improve various equipment, we can use what we used for our ordinary soldiers - special runes and runic symbols.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12509:description
Reward: The visions experienced by our Voluntee #217 allow him with a high probability to guess upcoming events. At the moment he "sees" not far, but even this greatly affects any outcome of the fight.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12510:description

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12511:description
Reward: Not only religion and occultism can provide answers. Most of our time we use different technologies. If we can combine all the teachings that we have, we can reach unprecedented heights in the discoveries to come.

freebie:5c0e4c5bca279:title: storage:12512:description
